title: APS Consulting Recruitment Notice
description:

Scope of Work and Responsibilities  

Consultants in this role primarily support research, policy analysis, and advisory work related to overseas political, regulatory, and governance developments. Typical tasks include:



Conducting background research and policy monitoring



Stakeholder mapping and engagement analysis



Drafting analytical briefs and memos



Supporting scenario planning and risk assessments for client decision-making



Types of Clients and Projects  

Our clients generally include private enterprises, professional institutions, and organizations with cross-border interests that require an informed understanding of overseas political, regulatory, or public-sector environments. Projects are research- and analysis-driven, and may relate to:



Public policy trends



Government processes



Geopolitical risk assessments



Work Structure (approximately 20 hours per week)  

This is a flexible, part-time consultancy arrangement. Work is typically project-based, with weekly hours varying depending on deliverables and timelines. Coordination is conducted remotely, and schedules are discussed in advance to align with both project requirements and consultant availability.

Non-governmental or international organizations

s, confidential matters. But the core of this role is bigger than that:

Tell me about a project you owned independently for an executive, from a vague request to a finished deliverable. What was it, what did you build, and how did you keep it moving without being chased?

s for the CEO. 30 are urgent. Walk me through your exact process.

title: Social Media Content Strategist *Superstar Only*
description:
We're hiring a Social Media Content Strategist to lead the creative vision, ideation, and strategic direction behind our short-form content engine across Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. This is the senior creative role on the social team. You are the person who has the ideas - who watches a long-form episode and immediately knows which fifteen seconds will stop a scroll, who sees a cultural 
nt and already has three concepts ready before anyone asks.



You will be working directly with a creator who has over 4 million followers across platforms, with Instagram as the primary channel. Our content operation is structured like a studio with batch production, performance metrics, and AI-native systems. You own the creative engine - the ideas, the concepts, the narrative direction, and the quality standard. You manage the Content Producer who handles daily execution, publishing, and platform operations. Together you run a system that produces high-volume, high-quality content every day.



This is a full-time remote position. We are looking for a senior creative operator who generates ideas naturally, understands modern platform dynamics at a deep level, actively integrates AI into workflows, and holds every piece of content to an elite standard. A genuine interest in health, beauty, and strong visual aesthetics is essential - this is the world we operate in, and you need to live and breathe it.



Responsibilities

- Generate and develop original content ideas, concepts, and creative angles on a continuous basis. You are the primary source of what we make and why.

- Identify high-retention 
nts within long-form content and develop them into short-form concepts with clear hooks, narrative arcs, and platform-specific angles.

- Develop creative briefs and direction for each content cycle, giving the Content Producer and editors clear guidance on what to build and how it should feel.

- Lead trend research and cultural awareness across TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts, spotting opportunities early and translating them into on-brand concepts.

- Translate brand strategy into high-performing content concepts, story structures, and creative playbooks that guide all short-form output.

- Define and evolve the brand's visual and tonal identity across platforms, maintaining a cohesive and premium creative standard.

- Direct and approve content through production and post-production, ensuring quality, creative alignment, and platform-ready formatting before anything publishes.

- Manage the Content Producer by setting priorities, providing creative direction, reviewing output, and ensuring disciplined execution of the publishing calendar.

- Analyze performance data at a strategic level, identifying what is working, why it is working, and how to double down or pivot.

- Build and optimize repeatable creative systems, including AI-driven workflows that streamline ideation, editing, and production.

- Partner with the production team to ensure social-first thinking is embedded in long-form content capture and planning.



Requirements

- 5+ years of experience in a creative strategy or production leadership role in digital media, YouTube, branded content, or entertainment with proven results.

- A natural idea generator who consistently develops strong content concepts, creative angles, and fresh approaches without waiting to be briefed.

- Genuine interest in health, beauty, and aesthetics. You naturally follow this space, understand the visual standards, and care about how things look and feel.

- Deep fluency in platform culture and trends. You know what is trending, why it is working, and how to adapt it to a creator's voice without losing authenticity.

- Strong understanding of storytelling, pacing, hooks, and modern platform dynamics across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, and emerging formats.

- Demonstrated experience managing at least one direct report and owning creative and performance outcomes.

- Proven ability to operate across creative strategy and production logistics while maintaining high quality standards.

- Editing and design literacy. You do not need to be the hands-on editor, but you must be able to direct editors and designers with precise, actionable feedback.

- AI-forward operator who actively integrates AI into creative and production workflows. Bonus for familiarity with tools such as Runway, VEO or Flow, ChatGPT, or Claude.

- Strong editorial judgment. You can look at a piece of content and immediately know what is missing, what is not working, and how to fix it.

- Excellent communication skills and ability to give clear, concise creative direction.

- Must submit a strong portfolio demonstrating creative direction, ideation, and platform-native content across multiple formats.

- Recognized for exceptional achievements such as attaining Latin Honors (Summa Cum Laude, Magna Cum Laude, Cum Laude), performance awards, or demonstrating fast career progression into higher roles.



Results

- A consistent pipeline of strong content ideas and creative concepts that drive the team's output forward.

- Trending sounds, formats, and cultural 
nts consistently identified and turned into on-brand content before they peak.

- A high-functioning creative system with predictable output and strong quality control.

- Content that reinforces the creator's positioning while maintaining consistency and a premium standard across platforms.

- Measurable increase in traffic from short-form content to long-form assets.



Requirements for Effective Remote Work

- Reliable computer or laptop capable of handling video production workflows.

- High-speed internet connection plus backup.

title: Social Media Content Producer *Superstar Only*

title: Character Illustrator-Animator | AI Visual Producer
description:
Prismiera is building an identity-forward jewelry brand using AI influencers. We're hiring a remote creative-production specialist for short-form videos, character design, animation, and charm.



We're looking for someone who can draw by hand as a baseline indicator for art fundamentals; whose work shows strong character taste — expression, gesture, emotional acting, aesthetic charm, and animation or storytelling instincts. AI tool experience is a plus, not a requirement. We can train the AI pipeline relatively quickly, but the artistic talent and execution ceiling we're looking for is not something we can teach. Therefore,



**We're especially interested in people who've built and sustained their own creative work — a channel, a webcomic, indie projects, a personal art practice, or deployed content for someone else with sustained self-directed shipping and creative exploration and ownership. If your background is more traditional (studio, agency, client work), that's fine too — we'll evaluate on the work itself.**



AI has collapsed the creative space into taste, artistic eye, experimentation, and speed of execution. So we're looking for execution discipline — you finish work, you iterate cleanly, you ship completed videos autonomously under shifting artistic demand, and you adapt quickly across different styles and mediums.



What you'll do



Steering, selecting, rejecting, refining, and sequencing AI-generated visuals so they match our shifting style demands, emotional tone, and character identity.



- Visual-audio judgment and strict curation of AI output

- Refine expressive character stills using AI tools, reference pools

- Generate motion video from curated stills using AI video tools (Seedance2, Kling — training provided)

- Time clips of varying styles to narration, and deliver finished 20–60 second character-led videos

- Curate ElevenLabs voiceover and attitude (guidance provided)

- Sequence and time motion clips against narration

- Keep recurring characters consistent across many pieces

- Help build reference systems and visual judgment language over time

- Document what worked, what failed, and why — so the system improves



Style direction

Character work with high emotional expressiveness — diverse emotional and stylistic grammar from shoujo/josei to shonen/seinen to other virality-native illustrated character storytelling styles. Work should feel alive and artist-directed, not randomly generated (your art has an opinionated, taste driven direction, not general). You can play across emotional registers — dramatic, comedic, melancholic, playful, action-driven.



We provide SOPs on content format and scripting, but having your own working sense of what makes content land + general virality sense, will make the process smoother.



You might be a fit if you

- Have visual substrate in character work — illustration, comics, animation, storyboards, VTuber assets, visual novels, AI character work, or another medium where expression and character consistency matter

- Can diagnose why a character feels off

- Sustain self-directed creative output

- Are curious about AI image and motion tools, even if you haven't used them extensively yet

- Can time visual beats to narration rhythm

- Communicate clearly and work well async



AI-assisted portfolios are welcome — we'll evaluate your execution.



Compensation

$800–$1,100 USD/month full-time depending on portfolio and trial performance. Higher long-term compensation available for candidates with autonomous judgment as we expand our worldbuilding and brand. We're looking for a long-term creative partner.



Trial period prior to confirmed engagement. Tool access and AI tool credits provided.



How to apply

Send:



Portfolio link — your best work. Ideally work you've deployed into your own channels or someone else's, or any creative project you've sustained over time, showcasing self-directed creative ownership.



Character or emotional pieces, showcasing your expressive range, charming aesthetic execution, etc.

Motion or sequence sample if available (animatic, short edit, Live2D/VTuber motion, AI motion, storyboard sequence, AE edits, etc)



To confirm you've read the full posting, include the phrase "character-first" in your application

Use at least 7 apply points.



Shortlisted candidates move into a paid two-week trial that may convert to a confirmed monthly retainer.

title: Events Coordinator
description:
About Lux Afrique



Lux Afrique is a luxury lifestyle, concierge, e-commerce and events company working across high-end experiences, luxury brand activations, private client events and international projects. Our events include luxury polo, exhibitions, VIP hospitality, brand partnerships, private shopping experiences and corporate activations across the UK, UAE and Africa.



We are looking for a highly organised, proactive and experienced Events Coordinator to join the team full-time and support the planning, delivery and execution of all Lux Afrique events.



Role Overview



The Events Coordinator will work across all Lux Afrique events, supporting the team from initial planning through to on-the-day delivery and post-event follow-up. This role requires someone with a minimum of 5 years’ experience in events, who is confident managing suppliers, partners, guests, sponsors and event logistics.



The ideal candidate will have experience working on luxury, lifestyle, hospitality, corporate or consumer events and must be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly.

Assist with event timelines, schedules, production plans, supplier trackers, guest lists, staffing plans and on-site briefing documents.

Supplier & Partner Management

Request quotes, compare suppliers, negotiate pricing where appropriate and ensure deliverables are clearly confirmed in writing.



Maintain strong relationships with suppliers and ensure they meet Lux Afrique’s luxury standards.



Guest & VIP Experience

Assist with ensuring the guest journey is smooth, professional and aligned with the Lux Afrique brand.



Help manage VIP hospitality areas, check-in, guest queries and on-site support during events.



Sponsorship & Brand Activations



Support the coordination of sponsors, partners and exhibitors.



Assist with sponsor deliverables, activation requirements, branding placement and post-event reporting.



Help ensure partners receive the agreed benefits and are supported before, during and after the event.



On-Site Event Delivery



Attend events and support with set-up, live event management and de-rig where required.



Act as a key point of contact for suppliers, staff and guests on-site.



Troubleshoot issues quickly and professionally.



Ensure the event space is presented to a high standard at all times.



Administration & Reporting



Maintain event documents, budgets, guest trackers, supplier databases and action plans.

Keep internal teams updated on progress, risks and outstanding actions.



Requirements

Strong experience managing suppliers, venues, contractors, sponsors, event staff and VIP guests.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Professional, polished and confident.

title: Social Media Video Post-Production Specialist
description:
About Us



We are a leading Australian caravan manufacturer and reseller, dedicated to building and delivering premium, adventure-ready caravans for the rugged Australian landscape. From off-road tourers to luxury family layouts, we create vehicles that inspire freedom. We are expanding our digital marketing team to showcase our builds, customer journeys, and lifestyle content through high-impact, driving video campaigns.



The Role



We are looking for a creative, fast-paced Social Media Video Post-Production Specialist to take our raw video assets—including product walk-throughs, factory builds, customer handovers, and rugged lifestyle footage—and turn them into high-performing video content.



In this role, you will analyse competitor benchmarks and reference content to craft thumb-stopping organic videos and highly optimised paid ads. Your work will directly fuel our presence across Meta 
 & Instagram), TikTok, and YouTube (including Google Ads).



Key Responsibilities



• Multi-Platform Video Editing: Cut, pace, and assemble high-impact short-form and mid-form videos customised for Meta Ads/Reels/Feeds, TikTok, and Google Ads, YouTube Shorts/Long-form.



• Paid Ad Optimisation: Build and iterate variations of high-converting video ads specifically for Meta and YouTube Ads, focusing on strong hooks, clear call-to-actions (CTAs), and direct-response formatting.



• Competitor & Reference Matching: Analyse provided competitor content, industry trends, and visual benchmarks to reverse-engineer high-performing video formats and elevate our brand's production value.



• Graphics & Text Overlays: Integrate clean typography, bold captions, lower thirds, and motion graphics optimised for mobile viewing (ensuring text stays within platform safe zones).



• Audio & Colour Correction: Perform crisp audio mixing (balancing wind noise, voiceovers, background tracks, and trending SFX) and apply clean, natural colour grading to make outdoor and lifestyle footage pop.



• Asset Pipeline Management: Maintain a highly organised digital library of raw footage, b-roll (factory, off-road, interior details), and completed masters for quick access and re-editing.



Capabilities & Core Skills



• Technical Proficiency: Expert knowledge of professional editing suites like Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro, alongside After Effects for motion graphics.



• Direct-Response Awareness: An understanding of what drives digital engagement and conversions—knowing how to hook an adventure-seeking audience within the first 3 seconds.



• Adaptability to Brand Voice: Ability to switch gears between rugged, high-energy off-road action edits and clean, aspirational, lifestyle-focused family caravan tours.



• Autonomous Workflow: Self-motivated and comfortable taking a folder of raw footage alongside reference links and turning it into a polished, final cut with minimal hand-holding.



Requirements

title: Right-Hand VA (Marketing Focused) — Clean Christian Music App
description:
We're looking for a sharp, creative, trend-obsessed marketer who lives on social media and loves using AI to make great content faster and smarter. The heart of this role is organic social — finding what's working right now, testing new content types before everyone else does, and turning scrolls into follows, clicks, and customers. You'll have real ownership over what we post, how it performs, and where we grow next.



If you get a little thrill from spotting a trend early, trying a format nobody's done yet, watching the analytics climb, and making a piece of content better than you found it — you'll fit right in. You don't need to have done all of this before, but you do need to be excited to learn. We use AI every day, and you'll use it to move faster: drafting, repurposing, researching, and creating gorgeous visuals.



It's a mixed role, and we want to be upfront about that. Organic social and marketing are the core of what we're hiring for — but you'll also help with customer service for our clean Christian music app, a bit of general admin, and whatever else a small, growing team needs. You need to be genuinely open to pitching in wherever we need you. We use tools like Claude (and Claude Code) every day, and we'll teach you how we work.



If you anticipate what's needed before being asked, take real ownership, communicate like a pro, and love learning something new — keep reading.



We're hiring the person, not the résumé. Creativity, instincts, and drive matter most; the rest we can teach — including the AI tools we build with.



What you'll do



Own our organic social (the core). Plan, create, and post across our platforms; catch trends early and act on them fast; test new content types and formats; build engaged audiences and keep them growing. This is the heart of the role.



Make scroll-stopping content — with an eye for design. Create visuals that look premium and on-brand, using AI image tools (Midjourney, Ideogram, gpt-image, and friends) to produce gorgeous images quickly. Good taste matters here.



Grow beyond organic. Pitch in on
 marketing, funnels, paid ads, and influencer marketing as we scale. You don't need to be an expert in all of it — but you should be eager to learn it and run with it.



Turn data into insight. Monitor analytics across platforms, spot what's working (and what's not), and bring us clear takeaways — not just numbers. Then double down on the winners.



Use AI to work faster and smarter. Lean on Claude / ChatGPT (and grow into Claude Code) to draft content, repurpose it across platforms, research, and automate the tedious parts of content ops. We'll teach you; you bring the curiosity.



Be my right hand. Anticipate needs, follow through without reminders, flag issues early, and close loops.



Support our clean Christian music app — content, community, customer service, and launch-related help.



Pitch in on the rest — light e-commerce / Etsy support and general admin as we grow.



A real love of music is a big plus — you'll be working in it every day.



Who you are (this matters most to us)



Creative and trend-obsessed — this is the big one. You live on social, you catch trends before they peak, and you have strong instincts for what makes people stop, save, and share.



An eye for design. You know what looks good, and you can create (or AI-assist) visuals that feel premium and on-brand.



Very proactive — a true self-starter. You take initiative instead of waiting to be told, teach yourself what you don't know, and your first instinct on a repetitive task is "can I make this faster?"



Tech-curious and AI-friendly. You're energized (not intimidated) by AI tools, and you're excited to use them every day to create and move faster. Any interest in automation or tinkering is a real plus.



Comfortable with numbers. You actually look at the analytics and let them guide your next test.



Great — not necessarily experienced. Eager, smart, proactive, and resourceful. We'd take a brilliant fast-learner over a seasoned coaster every single time.



Open and flexible. Happy to jump from a content project to a customer-service question to a quick admin task without missing a beat. You're here for the creative and marketing work, but you don't consider anything "below" you.



A clear communicator — responsive, easy to work with, and good at keeping us in the loop.



Reliable and professional — you do what you say you'll do, and you have a stable internet connection good enough to hold a video call and screen-share without dropping.



Honest and accountable — you log the time you actually work and speak up early when something's off. This one is non-negotiable.



Detail-oriented. To show us you read carefully, please mention your favorite color in your application where it asks how you heard about us.



Mission-aligned — you genuinely connect with what we're building: clean, faith-friendly music for families.



Helpful (but NOT required — we'll train you)



Hands-on organic social experience (TikTok, Instagram / Reels, Pinterest, YouTube Shorts,
).

Any experience with
 marketing, funnels, paid ads (Meta, etc.), or influencer marketing.

AI image generation (Midjourney, Ideogram, gpt-image) and design tools (Canva, Figma, etc.).

Using ChatGPT, Claude, or other AI tools in your daily workflow — bonus points for Claude / Claude Code or automation (n8n, Make, Zapier).

Reading analytics to spot trends and report results.

Pinterest / social media scheduling tools.

Customer service experience.

WordPress publishing.

Influencer outreach and management.

The details



Full-time, 40 hrs/week, long-term.

We start at $400–500/month and there's room to grow — in both pay and responsibility — as you take on more and grow into the wider marketing and AI side.

Based in the Philippines, with some flexibility to occasionally overlap U.S. Mountain Time for a quick call or chat.

We use the time tracker Trackabi for active work hours.

Benefits



Flexible hours — days, nights, spread out, or catch up on weekends.

PTO after 6 months full-time.

Paid training time to learn new skills on the clock.

A genuinely great team and culture. I treat my team like friends, not just freelancers — many have been with me for years, with no plans of leaving.

How to apply



Apply through the Google Form here:
 — that's the only way to apply, so please don't DM or
 instead.



Two quick things in the form:



When it asks about your experience with AI tools, tell us about a time you taught yourself something new — a tool, a content format, or a campaign — what you did and how it turned out. There's no "right" answer; we just want to see how you think and learn.



We're hiring one person and reviewing applications as they come in. Top candidates get a paid test project — your real chance to show us how you work.



If creating content, chasing trends, and using AI to do it all faster sounds more like a chore than something you'd genuinely enjoy, this probably isn't the right fit — and that's completely okay. But if everything above sounds like you, we'd genuinely love to meet you.

title: 3D Artist & Motion Designer To Produce Eerie Cathedral Virtual Stage Video Loops
description:
Project Overview:?I am a livestreaming musician looking for a talented 3D Artist / Motion Designer to build a series of highly atmospheric virtual stages. These will serve as pre-rendered video backgrounds behind a physical green screen using Ecamm Live to broadcast weekly live virtual concerts. Since the performance changes and evolves each week, and new shows with different stage backgrounds are in production, the right candidate could be employed consistently for roughly 10 hours a week or more for the long-term. 



The core aesthetic for this project is a vast, eerie cathedral or ancient monastery (dark gothic architecture, towering arches, stained glass, dimly lit corridors). A central element of this stage will be a mystical, magical video projection integrated into the environment and a single performer playing guitar and keyboards integrated seamlessly into the virtual stage. 



Key Responsibilities:

 • 3D Environment Modeling: Design a grand, gothic cathedral or monastery interior featuring large pillars, stone textures, and dramatic architectural depth.

 • Virtual Screen Integration: Seamlessly embed a 16:9 aspect ratio projection area into the cathedral background that plays video files provided by me. The screen should be styled as a magical, mystical projection (e.g., hovering ethereal mist, a magical energy field, or glowing ancient runes) rather than a modern LED wall.

 • Multi-Angle Perspective: Distort and skew the embedded 16:9 video playback window so it realistically matches the perspective and depth of a few different camera angles focused on the performer.

 • Lighting & Animation: Create eerie, moody light shows (flickering candlelight, moonlight piercing through stained glass, pulsing low-light columns, and lasers) looped to a steady tempo.

 • Atmospheric Visual Effects (VFX): Integrate thick volumetric stage fog, floating dust motes/particles, and realistic light shafts to create a haunting sense of scale.

 • Seamless Rendering: Export perfectly looping video files with zero visible cuts or jumps upon looping.



Required Skills and Qualifications:

 • Expertise in Blender, Unreal Engine, Cinema 4D, Autodesk Maya or whatever software gets the job done. 

 • Strong portfolio showcasing gothic, dark fantasy, or grand historical 3D environments.

 • Experience embedding external video textures/materials into a 3D environment with proper perspective warping.

 • Deep understanding of volumetric lighting, god rays, and atmospheric fog rendering.

 • Ability to structure the composition to leave a clear "performer pocket" in the center frame.



Technical Deliverables:

 • Format: MP4 or MOV

 • Resolution: 1080p (16:9 aspect ratio).

 • Framerate: 30fps

 • Duration: 30-to-60-second seamless loops.



Application Process & Screening Test

To be considered for this position, please reply with the following information:

 • A link to your portfolio, ArtStation, or video reel highlighting your best dark fantasy, gothic, or realistic 3D environments.

 • Your preferred 3D creation software.



?? Mandatory Screening Test Request:?To filter out automated spam applications, please use the phrase "DARK GOTHIC STAGE" as the subject of your application message.



Additionally, please attach or link to one single rendered image or video from your existing portfolio that you feel best proves you can handle volumetric fog and dramatic lighting effects. Applications without this specific sample will not be reviewed.

title: Takeoff Estimator (Junior) — Australian Concrete / FRP Drawings — Remote, Per Project

title: Management Accountant for Management Accounts Project - AI Integration Exp. MUST
description:
Management Accountant, Financial Dashboard Build (Short-term Project)



About the role:

We are looking for an experienced management accountant to join us on a short-term project (4-6 weeks) to build a live financial dashboard and supporting management accounts for a DTC ecommerce client.

This is a hands-on build role. You will be designing and delivering a daily financial dashboard that pulls data from multiple sources via APIs (Zapier, Airtable, Shopify, Meta Ads, bank feeds), presenting estimated and actual figures with variance reporting across revenue, cost of goods, advertising spend, staff costs and overheads. The dashboard needs to work on a rolling daily basis, with data refreshing within 24-48 hours of the source transactions.



You will be working under the direction of the Finance Director who will provide the data sets, access credentials and the overall structure. Your job is to take that brief and build the thing, working largely independently on the technical delivery.

What you will be building

The first deliverable is a daily financial dashboard with the following characteristics:

(a) High-level summary rows for revenue, cost of goods, gross profit, expenses, VAT and net profit, with drill-down capability into subcategories (advertising by channel, COGS by supplier, staff costs by source).

(b) Three-column structure per day: Estimate, Actual and Variance, with favourable/unfavourable variance logic built in.

(c) Dual views: an accruals-based dashboard and a cash-based dashboard.

(d) Populated initially with estimated costs (COGS from supplier invoices, staff costs from historical data, ad spend from recent actuals), then progressively replaced with live data as the API integrations come online.

(e) Connected via Zapier (or similar) to Shopify (UK, US and ROW stores), Meta Ads, TikTok Shop, Stripe, PayPal, Revolut, Wise, Remote and Airtable (creator contracts), pulling actuals automatically.

(f) Built with scalability in mind. The client is expanding into a group structure (multiple brands and entities), so the dashboard needs to be designed in a way that can be replicated and consolidated across additional businesses in the near future.

Following the dashboard build, you will assist with Xero integration work: aligning the chart of accounts, reconciling recent months and ensuring the management accounts output ties back to the dashboard figures.



What we need from you



Essential:

You are a qualified or part-qualified management accountant (CIMA or equivalent) with demonstrable experience building financial dashboards and management accounts from scratch, not just maintaining existing ones.

You are comfortable working with AI tools and using them in your workflow. This is not optional. We use Claude, ChatGPT and similar tools as part of our delivery process and expect you to do the same.

You have hands-on experience with API-driven data pipelines, whether through Zapier or direct API work. You need to be able to connect data sources, map fields and troubleshoot when feeds break.

You have experience with Xero (or a comparable cloud accounting platform) and understand how to structure a chart of accounts for ecommerce businesses with multi-channel, multi-currency revenue.

You can work independently with minimal supervision once given the brief and access.



Preferred:

Experience designing management accounts and dashboards for ecommerce, DTC or Shopify-based businesses.

Familiarity with A2X, Finaloop or similar ecommerce accounting connectors.

Experience building financial models that can scale across a company group (consolidated reporting, intercompany, multi-entity).

Understanding of contribution margin, MER (marketing efficiency ratio) and channel-level unit economics.

Practical details

This is a remote, freelance contract. Hours are approximately 20 to 30 per week for an initial 4-week period, with the possibility of extending to 6 weeks depending on progress. 



Rate is $8-15 per hour Depending on Experience.



There is potential for this to develop into a longer-term management accountant role as the client's group structure grows, but the immediate need is the project build.



To apply



Please include in your proposal:

(a) A copy of your CV.

(b) A brief summary of a financial dashboard or management accounts pack you have built from scratch, including what tools and data sources were involved.

(c) Your experience with Zapier or similar API/automation tools.

(d) Your accounting qualifications and level.

(e) Your availability to start (ideally within the next week).

title: Supply Chain Manager – E-Commerce Dropshipping (High Volume, 3,000+ SKUs)
description:
ABOUT US



We are U-S Limited, a fast-growing e-commerce company operating multiple successful dropshipping stores across different European markets. We run our own brands with 3,000+ active SKUs sourced from a wide network of suppliers and agents. We move serious volume, and the complexity of our supply chain grows every week — more suppliers, more invoices, constant price changes, and more moving parts. We are looking for an experienced Supply Chain Manager who can take full control of this and protect our margins.



THE ROLE



This is a high-volume, high-responsibility role. You will own our entire supplier and product operation. You will manage multiple suppliers, stay on top of every invoice and price change, and make sure our 3,000+ SKUs are always priced correctly, in stock, and fulfilled on time. A big part of this role is dealing directly with suppliers — and that means being a strong, direct communicator who verifies everything, questions incorrect charges, and holds suppliers accountable instead of accepting whatever they send. We need someone who is comfortable pushing back and negotiating hard to protect our pricing and margins.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



- Manage relationships with multiple suppliers and agents across different product categories

- Communicate directly and firmly with suppliers — verify pricing, question errors, and hold them to their terms

- Negotiate hard on pricing, volume discounts, shipping costs, and better terms

- Track, verify, and reconcile all supplier invoices — catch errors, double charges, and incorrect pricing before they cost us money

- Monitor price increases across all SKUs, flag them proactively, and calculate the margin impact

- Keep our 3,000+ SKU catalog accurate — cost prices, supplier links, shipping times, and stock status

- Monitor supplier performance: shipping times, defect rates, stock availability, and reliability

- Identify and resolve stockouts, fulfillment delays, and quality issues quickly

- Handle multi-currency cost tracking and understand the impact of FX on our margins

- Build and improve internal processes and systems to manage the supply chain at high volume

- Work directly with the CEO on sourcing strategy, cost optimization, and scaling decisions

- Take ownership and think proactively — anticipate problems instead of reacting to them



HARD REQUIREMENTS



- Proven experience managing supply chain or supplier operations for a high-volume e-commerce or dropshipping business — this is not a role for beginners

- You are used to working with large revenues, large order volumes, and large SKU catalogs (3,000+ SKUs)

- Experience managing multiple suppliers / Chinese agents at the same time

- A strong, direct communicator and hard negotiator — you are comfortable pushing back, questioning charges, and holding suppliers accountable

- Strong with numbers — you can spot pricing errors instantly, calculate margin impact, and reconcile invoices accurately

- Highly organized and detail-oriented — nothing slips through the cracks

- Analytical, proactive, and able to make decisions independently

- Comfortable working directly with the CEO in a fast-moving environment

- Strong written English



NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED)



- Experience with European dropshipping markets

- Familiarity with Shopify, supplier portals, and fulfillment systems

- Experience building spreadsheets / systems for cost tracking and supplier management



WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU



- Full-time remote role

- Direct collaboration with the CEO

- High ownership and real impact on company profitability

- Opportunity to grow into a senior operations or supply chain lead role

- Long-term position inside a fast-growing e-commerce business



HOW TO APPLY



To apply, send us:



- Your resume

- A short summary (3–5 sentences) of your experience — include how many suppliers, how many SKUs, and what order/revenue volume you managed

- Proof of your experience and results (cost savings you achieved, systems you built, supplier issues you resolved, screenshots, case studies, or data)

- A short explanation of how you stay on top of hundreds of invoices and constant price changes without losing control



Important: This role is for experienced, high-volume operators only. No proof = no answer. We do not respond to generic applications or applicants who cannot show real experience with serious volume — it wastes both your time and ours. To confirm you read the full post, include the word "ANCHOR" in your application.

You will own cold outbound prospecting on LinkedIn and Instagram, speed-to-lead phone follow-up for inbound leads, full CRM and pipeline management inside GoHighLevel, appointment confirmation, and re-engagement follow-up with warm prospects.

---

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



COLD OUTBOUND — LINKEDIN

- Use LinkedIn Sales Navigator to identify and research qualified prospects matching our ideal customer profile (U.S.-based real estate investors)

- Send personalized outbound connection requests and multi-step follow-up messages using approved scripts

- Manage all LinkedIn DM conversations and guide prospects toward a booked call

- Operate strictly within LinkedIn's daily outreach limits to protect account health and avoid restrictions

- Log all outreach activity and conversation outcomes inside the CRM daily



COLD OUTBOUND — INSTAGRAM

- Search relevant hashtags, accounts, and engagement signals to identify qualified prospects

- Send outbound DMs using approved messaging sequences tailored to our offer

- Manage all Instagram DM conversations and convert interest into booked calls

- Adhere strictly to Instagram's daily messaging limits and community guidelines to protect account standing

- Track all Instagram outreach and responses inside the CRM



INBOUND LEAD MANAGEMENT — SPEED TO LEAD

- Monitor inbound DMs on Instagram and LinkedIn from prospects responding to our paid ad campaigns

- Call every new inbound lead within 5 minutes of opt-in — no exceptions

- Intercept and support AI chatbot conversations when a live human response is needed

- Qualify leads over the phone using our qualification framework

- Book all qualified leads directly onto the sales calendar



CRM & PIPELINE MANAGEMENT (GoHighLevel)

- Keep the CRM clean, accurate, and fully up to date at all times

- Ensure every open conversation is responded to — no lead goes dark on your watch

- Move leads through pipeline stages correctly based on call and conversation outcomes

- Re-engage dormant leads in the pipeline through phone calls, texts, and DMs

- Remove unconfirmed appointments from the calendar to keep availability open for responsive prospects



APPOINTMENT CONFIRMATION & FOLLOW-UP

- Confirm every booked appointment in the window between booking and the scheduled call time

- Proactively remove no-confirm appointments from the calendar when a prospect becomes non-responsive

- Follow up with prospects who attended a sales call but did not close, with the goal of rebooking them with our closer

- Maintain a consistent follow-up cadence across all warm pipeline contacts



---



YOU ARE THE RIGHT FIT IF YOU HAVE:



- Proven experience as an appointment setter, outbound sales VA, or lead generation specialist

- Hands-on experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator (required — not negotiable)

- Real experience running outbound Instagram DM campaigns for lead generation (not just personal use)

- Deep understanding of LinkedIn and Instagram platform limits, warm-up best practices, and how to avoid account flags or restrictions

- Experience working inside GoHighLevel CRM (strongly preferred)

- Excellent English communication skills — written and spoken, confident on the phone with U.S. prospects

- A track record of making outbound phone calls and handling live conversations professionally

- High personal accountability for pipeline hygiene and daily activity targets

- Availability to work full-time during U.S. Eastern Time business hours

- Ability to self-manage, stay organized, and hit activity targets without micromanagement

---

TOOLS YOU WILL USE

- GoHighLevel (CRM, pipeline management, calendar, automations, messaging)

- LinkedIn Sales Navigator

- Instagram (organic outbound DM prospecting)

- Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Gmail)

---

TO APPLY



Please submit ALL of the following — incomplete applications will not be reviewed:

1. Your resume or CV

2. A 2–3 minute Loom video introducing yourself and walking us through your specific experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator and Instagram outbound outreach

3. A written answer (3–5 sentences) to this question: "Describe how you managed a CRM pipeline in a previous role. What did your daily routine look like, and how did you make sure no lead fell through the cracks?"



Applications without a Loom video will not be considered. We are hiring immediately and looking for someone who can hit the ground running from day one.



---



United Home Relief values reliability, communication, and results above all else. If you show up, follow the system, and do the work, there is a long-term home for you on this team.

title: SENIOR MARKETING & CHANNEL SPECIALIST | ELEVATED HOSPITALITY PARTNERS
description:
SENIOR MARKETING & CHANNEL SPECIALIST



ABOUT ELEVATED HOSPITALITY PARTNERS



Elevated Hospitality Partners is a growing vacation rental management platform supporting multiple local hospitality brands across Texas, New Mexico, and California. We manage high-quality vacation homes with a focus on strong homeowner partnerships, thoughtful guest experiences, local market expertise, and disciplined operational execution.



As we continue to grow, we are building a centralized marketing function that supports all of our markets, improves the performance of our listings, strengthens our homeowner acquisition efforts, and helps us present a consistent, premium brand across every channel.



ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and creative Senior Marketing & Channel Specialist to support marketing across our vacation rental portfolio.



This role will report to our Chief Commercial Officer and work closely with our market teams, revenue management, onboarding, field operations, and external marketing partners.



This is a hands-on marketing role focused on listing optimization, channel content quality, website updates, homeowner acquisition marketing, referral channel support, brand consistency, and select social media support. The ideal candidate is a strong writer, comfortable with digital tools, highly organized, and excited to help build scalable marketing processes for a growing hospitality business.



This role is especially important because our listings, websites, homeowner-facing content, and referral channels directly impact our ability to grow revenue, attract new homeowners, and create a premium brand experience across every market.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



LISTING OPTIMIZATION & CHANNEL CONTENT

* Own the quality, consistency, and optimization of property listings across Guesty, Airbnb, Vrbo, Google Vacation Rentals, direct booking websites, and other distribution channels.

* Write and refine listing titles, descriptions, summaries, photo captions, amenity highlights, and market-specific content.

* Review listings for completeness, accuracy, conversion quality, and brand consistency.

* Help determine the best hero images, photo order, captions, and property highlights for each listing.

* Coordinate with market teams to confirm property details, amenities, local recommendations, and unique selling points.

* Manage the listing optimization checklist for new and existing homes.

* Support the launch of new listings by ensuring marketing content is complete, accurate, and on-brand before going live.

* Review underperforming listings and recommend content, photo, or positioning improvements.

* Manage the relationship with photography partners to help ensure property photography is high quality, consistent, and aligned with our brand standards.

* Coordinate photography needs, shot lists, photo feedback, and follow-up requests with market teams and external photographers.



WEBSITE & DIRECT BOOKING SUPPORT

* Maintain and update property pages, market pages, owner-facing pages, and other website content.

* Ensure direct booking websites are accurate, polished, and aligned with current listings and brand standards.

* Support the creation of landing pages for market-specific campaigns, homeowner acquisition, and referral partners.

* Help improve website content for SEO, readability, and conversion.

* Coordinate with website vendors or internal tea
mbers when technical changes are needed.

* Support updates to Google Business Profiles and other local search assets.



HOMEOWNER ACQUISITION MARKETING

* Support marketing efforts designed to attract new vacation rental homeowners.

* Help create and maintain homeowner-facing materials, including one-pagers, brochures, market summaries, case studies, listing improvement examples, and sales support materials.

* Support
 campaigns, nurture sequences, and other marketing efforts for prospective homeowners.

* Help package the EHP value proposition clearly across markets, including our approach to home care, revenue management, guest experience, and owner communication.

* Create market-specific content that helps homeowners understand why our local teams are the right partner for their vacation rental.



REFERRAL CHANNEL MARKETING

* Support marketing efforts for referral partners, including real estate agents, brokers, developers, designers, contractors, and other local professionals who may refer homeowners to us.

* Help create referral partner collateral, outreach materials,
 campaigns, and follow-up content.

* Maintain referral channel marketing assets and ensure they are professional, clear, and easy for partners to share.

* Support the marketing side of our lifetime value of leads strategy, helping us stay visible and valuable to referral sources over time.

* Coordinate with leadership and market teams to identify partner opportunities and create simple, repeatable campaigns.



BRAND & CONTENT CONSISTENCY

* Help maintain consistent brand voice, tone, and visual standards across all markets and channels.

* Create and manage templates for listings, owner marketing, referral partners, social media, presentations, and website content.

* Use tools like Canva and Google Workspace to produce clean, professional, on-brand marketing materials.

* Ensure each local brand feels personal and market-specific while still reflecting the quality and standards of Elevated Hospitality Partners.



REPORTING & PROCESS MANAGEMENT

* Maintain a marketing tracker for listing optimization, website updates, referral marketing, owner acquisition campaigns, and active projects.

* Provide regular updates to the Chief Commercial Officer on progress, priorities, and blockers.

* Track key marketing activity, including listings optimized, new listings launched, website pages updated, referral materials created, and campaigns supported.

* Help build repeatable marketing processes as we scale across markets.

* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, consistency, and quality across our marketing work.



SOCIAL MEDIA

* Support social media content across our brands, with a primary focus on homeowner brand awareness and homeowner acquisition rather than guest marketing.

* Create and maintain a simple content calendar focused on brand credibility, homeowner education, market presence, property highlights, team stories, and referral partner visibility.

* Repurpose listing content, market insights, owner-facing content, and local stories into social media posts.

* Create professional, on-brand graphics and short-form content using Canva or similar tools.

* Ensure social media supports the broader business goal of building trust with homeowners and referral partners.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

* Listings are polished, accurate, compelling, and consistent across channels.

* New homes are launched with complete and high-quality marketing content.

* Website and direct booking content stays current and professional.

* Homeowner acquisition materials are organized, clear, and easy for the sales team to use.

* Referral partner marketing is consistent and professional.

* Photography partners receive clear direction and deliver brand-aligned property photos.

* Marketing projects are tracked, prioritized, and completed on time.

* The company has stronger marketing systems that can scale across multiple markets.



IDEAL CANDIDATE

* Excellent written English and strong editing skills.

* Experience in digital marketing, hospitality marketing, vacation rental marketing, real estate marketing, or a similar field.

* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage many listings, projects, and deadlines.

* Experience writing marketing copy for websites, listings,
s, or social media.

* Comfort working with digital platforms, website builders, channel tools, spreadsheets, and project trackers.

* Strong Canva or basic graphic design skills.

* Good understanding of brand consistency and premium presentation.

* Ability to work independently, ask smart questions, and organize work clearly.

* A proactive, problem-solving mindset.

* Interest in hospitality, travel, real estate, and vacation rentals.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

Experience with any of the following is helpful, but not required:

* Airbnb, Vrbo, 
, or Google Vacation Rentals

* Guesty or another property management system

* Vacation rental or short-term rental marketing

* Real estate or property management marketing

* Website CMS tools

* Google Business Profile

* Google Analytics

* Meta Business Suite

*
 marketing tools

* SEO basics

* Photography coordination or creative direction



TOOLS YOU MAY USE

* Guesty

* Airbnb

* Vrbo

* Google Vacation Rentals

* Google Workspace

* Canva

* Meta Business Suite

* Google Business Profile

* Website builder tools

* Project management or tracking tools

* AI writing and productivity tools



COMPENSATION

* Full-time remote role based in the Philippines

* Compensation: $1,200-$1,500 USD per month, depending on experience

* 13th month pay

* Full-time schedule

* 90-day performance and compensation review

* Long-term growth opportunity as our marketing function expands



WORKING HOURS

• This is a full-time role aligned to U.S. Central Time.

• Required schedule: 9:00am-5:00pm Central Daylight Time, Monday-Friday.

• 9:00am-5:00pm CDT = 10:00pm-6:00am PHT.

• Because the Philippines does not observe daylight saving time, the Philippines time equivalent may shift when the U.S. changes between CDT and CST.

• Candidates must be comfortable working overnight Philippines hours on a consistent basis.





APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS



To apply, please submit the following:



1. RESUME OR WORK HISTORY

Please share your resume, LinkedIn profile, or a short summary of your relevant work experience.



2. MARKETING PORTFOLIO OR EXAMPLES

Please include examples of marketing work you have created or managed. This could include:



* Vacation rental listings

* Airbnb, Vrbo, or 
 listing copy

* Website pages

* Real estate or hospitality marketing materials

* Social media content

*
 campaigns

* Brochures, one-pagers, or Canva designs

* Before-and-after examples of listings or marketing content you improved



We are especially interested in examples related to short-term rentals, vacation rentals, hospitality, real estate, travel, or local service businesses.



3. VACATION RENTAL / OTA EXPERIENCE



Please briefly answer the following:

* Have you worked with Airbnb, Vrbo, 
, Google Vacation Rentals, Guesty, or other vacation rental platforms?

* Have you optimized vacation rental listings before? If yes, what changes did you make?

* What do you look for when trying to improve the performance of a vacation rental listing?

* What process or checklist do you use to make sure a listing is complete, accurate, and attractive to guests?

* How do you think about the differences between Airbnb, Vrbo, direct booking websites, and other OTAs?



4. LISTING OPTIMIZATION CASE STUDY

Please review the following Airbnb listing: 



After reviewing the listing, please provide a concise recommendation for how you would improve it.



Your response should include:

* A brief summary of your overall impression of the listing.

* An optimized listing title. Please provide one title you believe would perform well on Airbnb and briefly explain why.

* A rewritten and optimized version of the listing. Please rewrite the full listing copy, including the main description, property/space details, location information, guest access, and any important notes you believe should be included. The listing should be written to clearly present the property, highlight its most compelling features, and drive conversion to booking.

* Your top 5 recommended improvements. These can relate to copy, photo order, amenities, guest expectations, OTA performance, direct booking potential, or anything else you believe would improve the listing.

* Your approach to listing optimization. Briefly explain the process you would normally use when reviewing and improving a vacation rental listing.



Please keep your response practical and concise. We are looking for clear writing, strong judgment, and an understanding of how to improve vacation rental listing performance.



WHY JOIN US

This is an opportunity to join a growing hospitality business at an early stage and help build the marketing engine for a multi-market vacation rental platform. You will have the chance to make a direct impact on listing performance, homeowner acquisition, referral partner marketing, and brand growth across several unique vacation rental markets.



We are looking for someone who is thoughtful, organized, creative, and excited to help build something that can scale.

description:
APPOINTMENT SETTER FOR A MEDICAL SPA (Part-Time, Growing to Full-Time)



We are a growing medical spa, and we are looking for a skilled Appointment Setter to help us turn interest into booked appointments and grow our memberships and treatment sales. We offer high-value aesthetic treatments, including Botox, fillers, and laser services, to an established client base.



Our team is focused on delivering treatments in the clinic, so inbound and follow-up calls often go unanswered and warm leads sit longer than we would like. You would step in to close that gap and become the voice that follows up when the clinic gets busy, so no lead goes cold and every interested client gets a timely, knowledgeable conversation.

Above all, this is a communication role. You are often the first real conversation a client has with us, so clear, warm, and confident communication matters more here than anything else.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Calls and client communication (the core of this role)

- Make outbound follow-up calls to existing clients to check on their treatment experience and introduce additional treatments they have shown interest in.

- Work and qualify leads coming in from
, Google, and landing page campaigns, and call them promptly, so interest turns into booked appointments.

- Answer inbound calls during and after clinic hours, so callers reach a real person when the team is with clients.

- Book appointments and sell memberships, working toward at least one sale per day as you settle into the role.

- Speak knowledgeably about our treatment menu and recommend the right services based on the concerns each client raises.

- Help build and refine our call scripts together with the owner, since formal scripts are not yet in place.

- Track lead status and follow-ups, and keep client records and notes current.

Light marketing support (secondary to the call work)

- Lend a hand with basic social media and marketing when the team is stretched, including occasional video editing.

- General familiarity with how social campaigns support lead generation is welcome. Deep expertise is not expected.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Excellent communication is the most important quality for this role. You are clear, warm, and confident on the phone, with strong spoken and written English, and you can guide a conversation naturally toward a booking.

- Genuine sales experience. Our treatments are high-ticket, so you are comfortable in real sales conversations and confident asking for the booking or the sale.

- Coachable and eager to learn the treatment menu in detail, with the goal of speaking to it confidently within the first week.

- Comfortable handling client profiles and confidential information with discretion.

- Common-sense familiarity with social media and basic marketing is a plus, not a requirement.



TOOLS

- A CRM to track leads, follow-ups, and sales status, with calling and messaging handled in the same system. We provide full onboarding on the tools.

- Slack for client matters, plus a team group chat for day-to-day coordination.



SCHEDULE

- Part-time to start, with room to grow into full-time as call volume increases.

- Mountain Time hours.

- Occasional attendance at tea
etings.



FIRST 30 DAYS

- Become fluent in our treatments and able to speak to them confidently with clients.

- Begin working the existing lead list and making consistent follow-up calls.

- Help shape the first set of call scripts alongside the owner.

- Build toward the working sales target as your familiarity with the menu and clients grows.

title: Electrical Engineer / Hardware Designer — IoT Product Development
description:
We are an American technology company building a line of IoT hardware products for the professional B2B market. We are looking for a part-time electrical engineer to own the hardware side of our product development from schematic design through PCB fabrication and component sourcing.



This is not a one-off freelance project. This is an ongoing role on a small, focused team. You will be our hardware person. We have multiple products planned over the next 1–2 years, starting with a battery-powered e-paper display system. Our software and firmware are handled by a separate team. Your focus is the physical electronics: circuit board design, component selection, PCB ordering, and coordination with mechanical/enclosure designers.



What You Will Do

• Design schematics and PCB layouts in KiCad based on specifications we provide

• Select components and source parts from LCSC, Mouser, DigiKey, and AliExpress

• Generate manufacturing files and order assembled PCBs from JLCPCB

• Read datasheets, verify pin assignments, check footprints, and confirm compatibility before ordering

• Troubleshoot assembled boards (we will provide test equipment as needed)

• Coordinate with enclosure designers on board dimensions, mounting holes, and connector placement

• Maintain organized project files in Git (we will set up repositories for you)

• Communicate daily via chat/messaging and weekly via video call



Current Project

Your first project is two small I2C expansion boards for an ESP32-S3-based e-paper display product:

Board A - Button Strip: A long narrow PCB (~260mm × 15mm) carrying an MCP23017 GPIO expander, 7 IP67 sealed tactile switches, a WS2812B addressable RGB LED, an LIS3DH accelerometer, a DRV5032 hall effect sensor, a piezo buzzer with MOSFET driver, ESD protection, and Qwiic/STEMMA QT connectors. Standard I2C bus, 3.3V logic, straightforward 2-layer board.

Board B - NFC Reader: A small PCB carrying a PN532 NFC module and a Qwiic connector. Very simple board.

Additionally: specify battery contacts and wiring harness for a 21700 lithium cell, and create a connection guide documenting how the expansion boards wire to the main driver board.

The full technical specification for these boards is already written and will be provided to the person we hire. All design decisions have been made: component choices, I2C addresses, pin allocations, connector types. Your job is to translate the specification into working KiCad files, order boards from JLCPCB, and verify they work.



Future Projects

After the expansion boards, upcoming hardware work includes:

• Enclosure design coordination (working with a mechanical designer)

• A barcode/document scanner accessory

• RFID scanners

• Possible custom main board (consolidating the current off-the-shelf driver board into a single integrated PCB)

• Other IoT accessories for our product platform



This role grows as the product line grows.



________________________________________



Requirements



Must Have

• Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or closely related field

• Ability to read and understand component datasheets, application notes, and reference designs

• Working knowledge of basic electronics: I2C, SPI, GPIO, pull-up resistors, decoupling capacitors, voltage regulators, MOSFETs

• Experience with KiCad (Or strong willingness to learn. If you know Altium, Eagle, or EasyEDA, KiCad will come quickly.)

• Experience ordering PCBs from JLCPCB, PCBWay, or similar fab houses

• Careful and detail-oriented - you double-check footprints before ordering, you verify pin assignments against the datasheet, you ask questions when something is unclear

• Strong written English communication

• Reliable internet connection and availability during overlapping work hours (we are in US Pacific time, UTC-8)



Nice to Have

• Experience with ESP32 or other microcontroller platforms

• Experience with I2C sensor boards, GPIO expanders, or NFC modules

• Familiarity with Git/GitHub for version control

• Experience with JLCPCB's SMT assembly service specifically (BOM formatting, CPL files)

• Any experience with e-paper/e-ink displays

• Experience with consumer or IoT product development (not just academic projects)

• RF or antenna design



Not Required

• Firmware or software development (we handle this)

• Mechanical / enclosure design (potentially separate role, but you will coordinate with that person)

• High-speed digital or power electronics



Strong Bonus

Experience with 3D CAD (Fusion 360 or SolidWorks) for enclosure design. Our products require custom 3D-printed enclosures, and a candidate who can own both the electronics and the enclosure design will be prioritized and compensated at the higher end of the range. If you have designed and 3D-printed enclosures for electronics projects - even personal or academic projects - please include photos, CPL files)



________________________________________



Work Arrangement

• Hours: 20 hours per week to start, with potential to increase as projects grow

• Schedule: Flexible, but we need at least 2–3 hours of overlap with US Pacific time (evenings in the Philippines typically work well) for real-time communication

• Communication: Daily async updates via chat (Slack or similar), weekly 30-minute video call for project sync

• Tools we provide: GitHub repository access, KiCad project templates, all component datasheets and specifications, JLCPCB account or reimbursement for fabrication orders

• Duration: Ongoing, long-term. This is not a 1-month contract. We are building a multi-year product line and want someone who grows with us.



________________________________________



Compensation

?45,000–65,000/month (~$800–1,200 USD) 

Payment monthly via bank transfer, PayPal, or Wise.



________________________________________



How to Apply



Please provide:

1. Your resume or CV with education, work experience, and any relevant projects

2. 2 or more examples of PCBs you have designed - KiCad screenshots, Gerber renders, or photos of assembled boards. Academic projects are fine if you have no professional examples. If you have not designed a PCB before, please be honest about that.

3. A brief message (3-5 sentences) explaining why this role interests you and what relevant experience you have

4.     A short video introduction (1–2 minutes, phone camera is fine). Please tell us your name, your educational background, one electronics project you've worked on that you're proud of, and why this role interests you. We are not evaluating production quality - we want to hear how you communicate and learn a bit about your experience in your own words.



Paid Screening Task

Qualified applicants will be invited to complete a short paid test ($20 USD):

We will send you a schematic of an existing circuit board and a component datasheet. Using those references, draw a schematic (in KiCad, by hand, or in any tool you prefer) showing how to connect an MCP23017 I2C GPIO expander to an ESP32-S3's I2C bus with 4 tactile button inputs, proper pull-up resistors, decoupling capacitors, and debounce capacitors. Include I2C device addressing.



This should take 30-60 minutes for someone comfortable with I2C and basic schematic capture. We are evaluating: correctness of the circuit, understanding of I2C fundamentals, attention to detail (pull-ups, decoupling, addressing), and clarity of the schematic.



Everyone who completes the test will be paid regardless of whether we hire them.



________________________________________



About Us

We are a small US-based technology company building software and hardware products for a specialized professional market. Our software platform is in active development. The hardware products are IoT accessories that connect to our software platform via WiFi/MQTT. We are a small team that values clear communication, careful work, and people who take ownership of their area.



This is a real company building real products. We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us, not someone looking for a quick gig.



________________________________________



To Apply

Send your application through OnlineJobs.ph with your resume, PCB examples (if any), and your brief message. We will respond to all qualified applicants within 3–5 business days.

Phase one covers approximately the first 30 to 60 days. Your primary focus is rental leasing operations — managing leads, following up relentlessly, and moving prospects through the pipeline from first inquiry through signed lease. Phase two begins as the portfolio stabilizes. Your focus shifts to systems building, investor and buyer support, and social media and YouTube content operations. This is where the role grows into something more strategic and more interesting for the right candidate.

 Marketplace, and

, and TikTok using scheduling tools

Monitor the dedicated operations
 inbox

Draft routine
 and message responses for founder review and approval

Organize files and documents in Google Drive

Schedule and confirm appointments on the founder's calendar



What We Are Looking For:



Required:

Phone confidence in English. You will be calling and receiving calls from US-based rental prospects, tenants, vendors, contractors, and investors. Your spoken English must be clear and professional. This will be evaluated in your Loom video and confirmed in the interview. Candidates from BPO or US-facing call center backgrounds are strongly encouraged to apply.

, ClickUp automations, or a comparable CRM automation tool. Knowing how to use a tool is not enough. We need someone who has built something in it. Be specific in your application about what you built.

Follow-through without being reminded. This operation has many open items running simultaneously. Leads that do not get followed up fall through. Vendors that are not chased miss deadlines. You close every loop. We need a specific real example from your work history, not a general claim.

Project management tool experience. ClickUp, Asana, Monday, or equivalent. You will live in ClickUp daily.

Detail orientation you can prove with a specific story.

GoHighLevel experience specifically. Pipelines, workflows, automations, campaigns, and conversation management.


 experience. Building multi-step scenarios, not just connecting two apps.

Experience supporting a US-based entrepreneur or small business owner directly.

Spanish fluency. We work with a large Spanish-speaking investor, tenant, vendor, and buyer population in Central Florida. A bilingual candidate is a significant operational asset.

title: Google Flow AI Generation VA — Long-Term, Recurring Weekly Pay Apex Initiative · TikTok Shop Affiliate Coaching
description:
Google Flow AI Generation VA — Long-Term, Recurring Weekly Pay

Apex Initiative · TikTok Shop Affiliate Coaching



PAY: $5 USD per hour, paid every Sunday via Wise or PayPal.

Work week is Monday–Saturday.

Typical hours: 30–45 per week depending on volume (each project ~30 minutes).



SCHEDULE: 6 days per week, flexible within your timezone

TYPE: Long-term, recurring hourly work — NOT a one-off gig

START: Immediate



———————————————————



WHAT WE DO



Apex Initiative is a coaching company helping students build TikTok Shop affiliate businesses in the UK and US. We produce all our content using Google Flow (Google's AI video tool), and we're building a small, stable team of long-term VAs to handle daily generation work for our coaching clients.



———————————————————



WHAT YOU'LL DO EACH DAY



You'll work directly inside the student's Google Flow account (they share the login with you) using Nano Banana Pro for image generation and Flow's animation for video.



The student (or our team lead) sends you a set of "projects" daily. One project = approximately 25–30 base product images pulled from KaloData (the TikTok Shop product research tool). Most students send 2–4 projects per day, depending on how many TikTok accounts they're running.



For each project, you will:



1. Log into the student's Google Flow account

2. For each base image in the project: use Nano Banana Pro to generate an AI creative image following our standard image prompt

3. Animate that creative image into a short video using our standard video prompt

4. Save the finished video to a Google Drive folder named "Project 1," "Project 2," etc. (numbering resets every day)

5. Repeat for all 25–30 base images in the project



A skilled VA completes one project in about 30 minutes.



At end of day, you hand off the day's Drive folders to the assigned Posting VA, who pulls from your folders and handles the actual TikTok posting. You'll coordinate directly with the Posting VA via 
 or Line so the handoff is clean. The student tells the Posting VA which project goes to which account — you just need to make sure the project folders are labeled correctly and uploaded on time.



———————————————————



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



- Excellent written English

- Reliable high-speed internet (Google Flow is browser-based, bandwidth matters)

- Modern computer or laptop with Chrome browser (smartphone is NOT enough for this role)

- 6 days/week availability

- Strong attention to detail — you'll need to judge whether each AI output is usable

- Comfortable following SOPs precisely (no improvising)

- Comfortable coordinating daily with another VA (the Posting VA who pulls from your Drive folders)



Bonus: prior experience with AI generation tools (Midjourney, ChatGPT, Runway, Google Flow, Sora, Nano Banana, etc.)



———————————————————



HOW TO APPLY



Send the following:



1. A 2–3 minute Loom video — introduce yourself, your VA experience, and mention any experience with AI tools

2. Your resume or CV

3. Your timezone + weekly availability (hours/day, days/week)

4. Confirmation you have a computer with Chrome, reliable internet, and can commit 6 days/week

5. Type the phrase "APEX-READY-GENERATION" at the top of your application so we know you read this in full



Applications missing item #5 will not be reviewed. We get a lot of applications and use this to filter for people who actually read the listing.



———————————————————



3-DAY PAID TRIAL



If we like your application, you move into a 3-day paid trial period:



- We walk you through our full Google Flow Generation SOP via Loom + a short 1:1 call so you know exactly what to do

- You're assigned to one of our students (you use their Google Flow account login)

- You generate the daily target of AI images + videos for 3 days, following the prompts exactly

- We monitor your output daily and give feedback in real time

- Pay during the trial: regular $5/hour rate for all hours worked — no unpaid testing

- Pass the trial = you continue with that student permanently

- If it's not the right fit, we release you with full pay for hours worked



———————————————————



WHY WORK WITH APEX



- Stable weekly income paid every Sunday — predictable, never late

- Long-term role (we want VAs for 6+ months minimum)

- Work directly with cutting-edge AI tools — Google Flow and Nano Banana Pro are some of the newest in the space

- Clear written SOPs — you never have to guess what to do

- Friendly, organized team

- Performance-based raises after 90 days

- Path to a VA Manager role for top performers



If you're looking for a real long-term job and want to grow with a stable team, we'd love to hear from you.



— Apex Initiative Team

title: HR Generalist & Recruiter – Must Have Performance Marketing Agency Background
description:
About HypeTribe Asia

HypeTribe is a venture studio building and scaling D2C brands across health, wellness, and digital marketing.

We're AI-native, lean, and ship daily. We hire performance marketers, creatives, and operators across multiple time zones — and we need an HR partner who will work under one of the portfolio companies of Hypetribe and actually understands the talent we're recruiting.



Why this role is different

Most HR people don't know what a "media buyer" actually does, or how to spot a real prompt engineer vs. someone who just listed "AI" on their résumé. That's exactly why we're specifically looking for someone who has worked inside a performance marketing agency, growth agency, or D2C marketing team before. You've seen these roles up close. You know what a great media buyer looks like in an interview, how to vet a copywriter's portfolio.



If you've never sat next to a media buyer or watched a creative team brief out ad concepts, this role is not for you.



What you'll own



1. End-to-end recruitment for media buyers, copywriters, prompt engineers, creative strategists, video editors, ops roles, etc across multiple brands

2. Sourcing (OnlineJobs, LinkedIn, Upwork, referrals), screening calls, scorecards, interview coordination, reference checks

3. Negotiating and closing offers — comp, scope, start dates

4. HR admin: contracts, onboarding, time tracking, payroll coordination, performance check-ins, offboarding

5. General admin tasks supporting founders and managers — calendar coordination, document management, internal communications, ad-hoc operational support

6. Building and maintaining hiring SOPs, candidate pipelines, and ATS workflows (we systematize everything)

7. Compliance and documentation across multiple jurisdictions

8. Using AI daily to accelerate sourcing, screening, drafting JDs, summarizing interviews, and admin



You're a strong fit if you have



1. You have worked on a performance marketing agency, growth agency, or D2C marketing team — in HR, talent, ops, recruiting, or account management

2. Direct experience hiring or recruiting media buyers, copywriters, or creative talent

3. Strong negotiation skills — you can close candidates and push back on unreasonable asks

4. Deep comfort with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.) — you use them every day, not just when it's convenient

5. Highly organized and proactive — you can run 10+ open roles across 4 brands without dropping a ball

6. Excellent written and spoken English

7. Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift weekly and you wear multiple hats



Bonus points



1. Experience hiring across international markets (US, EU, PH, LATAM)

2. Background in health & wellness, telehealth, or supplements

3. Experience writing or refining job descriptions that actually attract A-players

4. Graduated from one of the Philippines' top universities, including:



University of the Philippines (UP)

Ateneo de Manila University (ADMU)

De La Salle University (DLSU)

University of Santo Tomas (UST)



What we offer



1. Competitive salary, based on experience and what you bring

2. Long-term, full-time role with real growth — as we add brands, you build the team

3. Direct exposure to founders and the inner mechanics of a fast-scaling venture studio

4. AI tools, software, and training fully covered

5. A team that values speed, ownership, and intelligence.





HOW TO APPLY

In your message, answer these four questions (short, direct answers — no fluff):



1. Which performance marketing agency or D2C company have you worked at, and what was your role? Briefly describe what the company did and the talent you saw being hired.

2. Describe one media buyer, copywriter, or creative hire you were involved in. How did you evaluate them, and what made them a fit (or not)?

3. Which AI tools do you use weekly, and give one concrete example of how you used AI in your last role.
