title: Digital Marketing Coordinator (Content, Operations & Systems)
description:
About DCB Digital

We're a growing Queensland-based digital marketing agency working with professional services and trades businesses across Australia. We specialise in web design, SEO, paid ads, and social media, and we work with clients who are serious about getting results.

We're a small, focused team that cares about doing good work properly. Everyone here is across real client accounts from day one and expected to take ownership of their area without needing to be managed closely.



About the role

We're looking for a Digital Marketing Coordinator who wants to grow with us, not just fill a seat.

This is a broad role and that's intentional. You'll work directly alongside the Directors across content creation, social media, AI, automations, operations, systems, and client support. In the short term you'll also be across social media delivery as we transition away from that service. For the right person, that's an opportunity to get across every part of how a digital agency runs and build from there.

We use AI properly here. Not as a gimmick, but as a core part of how we work. We're building automations, running AI agents, and integrating AI tools across the agency as it grows. This person needs to be genuinely across that world, not just familiar with it.

We're not looking for someone who needs a lot of direction. We're looking for someone who spots what needs doing, does it well, and is always thinking about how to do it better.



How we work

We don't measure success by how many tasks got completed. We measure it by outcomes. Every piece of work we do has a reason behind it and we expect everyone on the team to understand that reason, not just execute the task.

If you're the kind of person who asks "what are we actually trying to achieve here" before diving in, you'll fit right in. If you'd rather just be told what to do and get it done, this probably isn't the right place for you.

We're always looking at how we can do things better, get stronger results for our clients, and improve how the agency runs. We want someone who thinks the same way, comes with ideas, and isn't satisfied with good enough.



What you'll be doing

Director and client support



Managing the Directors' inboxes and calendars

Scheduling meetings, managing deadlines, and protecting their time

Drafting and responding to
s on behalf of the Directors

Assisting with client communications and following up with clients as needed

Taking notes during client calls and sending follow-up summaries and next steps

Keeping communication moving so nothing gets missed



Social media, content creation and account growth



Designing graphics and social assets in Canva across multiple client brands

Basic graphic design work beyond Canva where required

Editing short-form video for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and Stories using CapCut and AI-assisted tools

Writing captions suited to each client's tone and audience

Creating and managing content across LinkedIn, Meta, and TikTok

Managing content calendars across multiple client accounts

Scheduling and publishing content across LinkedIn, Meta, and TikTok via Later, Buffer, or Meta Business Suite

Growing client accounts and DCB Digital's own accounts through organic and paid strategies

Staying across platform trends on LinkedIn, Meta, and TikTok and applying them quickly

Monitoring account performance and adjusting content strategy based on what the data shows

Optimising profiles, posting cadence, and engagement tactics to drive consistent growth

Managing client Slack channels and keeping communication organised

Pulling performance reports and flagging what needs attention

Responding to comments and DMs on client accounts as required



SEO, website and content support



Uploading and formatting blog posts and pages across client websites in WordPress

Assisting with content briefs and outlines during busy periods

Light editing of SEO content before it goes live

Resizing and compressing images for web use, with correct file naming and alt text

Preparing and optimising all assets before they go near a website

Quality checking websites before and after updates go live

Reviewing content for accuracy, formatting, and consistency before it reaches the client

Pulling reports from Google Search Console, GA4, and other platforms



AI and automations



Working daily with our AI stack including Claude, ChatGPT, Paperclip, and Hermes

Using Hermes as part of your daily workflow and helping build and manage it as the agency develops

Building and maintaining automations in 
 and Zapier from scratch

Helping integrate AI tools across agency workflows as we grow

Identifying where AI and automation can remove bottlenecks and flagging opportunities to the Directors

Keeping across new AI tools and developments and bringing relevant ones to the table



Operations, systems and research



Ensuring Zoho is updated daily across all active client accounts

Assisting with onboarding new clients and getting them set up correctly in Zoho

Keeping track of client deliverables and deadlines across the agency

Following up with the team to make sure work is on track and nothing is slipping

Chasing outstanding tasks and keeping the Directors informed of anything at risk

Organising and maintaining folder structures across all client accounts

Building and documenting processes and SOPs into a proper agency system

Supporting the broader DCB tech stack as it grows

Collecting data and conducting research for client reporting and new business

Competitor and market research across both client accounts and agency growth

Collating findings into clear, usable formats for the Directors

Ad hoc project support across the agency as needed



Basic bookkeeping support



Collecting and uploading receipts to Xero

Reconciling receipts and categorising expenses

Chasing missing receipts when flagged by our bookkeeper

Keeping the accounts clean between bookkeeper reports





Tools you'll need to know



Canva and basic graphic design

CapCut and AI video editing tools

Instagram,
, LinkedIn, and TikTok (content creation, management, and scheduling)

Later, Buffer, or Meta Business Suite

Claude, ChatGPT, Paperclip, and AI agent workflows


 and Zapier (building from scratch, not just maintaining)

Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive)

WordPress

Slack

Zoho

ClickUp or similar project management tools

Xero (basic receipt and expense management)

Google Search Console and GA4





What we need from you



Proven experience working inside a digital marketing agency (non-negotiable)

Strong English, written and spoken, you'll be communicating with clients and on behalf of the Directors

Solid content creation skills across Canva, Instagram, and short-form video

Basic graphic design skills beyond Canva

Proven experience creating and managing content across LinkedIn, Meta, and TikTok

Proven experience growing social media accounts organically and through paid activity

Someone who is genuinely across platform trends and knows how to use them, not just someone who follows them passively

Genuine hands-on experience building automations in 
 or Zapier from scratch

Real working knowledge of AI tools including Claude, ChatGPT, and AI agents, not just a passing familiarity

Comfortable working alongside and helping develop AI agents as part of daily operations

A solid understanding of SEO basics and how digital marketing agencies operate

Experience managing a busy inbox and calendar on behalf of someone else

Strong research skills and an ability to turn data into something useful

A sharp eye for quality, errors, and inconsistencies

A genuine drive to do things better, someone who brings initiative and fresh thinking rather than waiting to be told

Comfortable with Xero at a basic level

Highly organised with the kind of attention to detail that means things don't fall through the cracks

Someone who follows through without being chased and communicates proactively when something is off





What we offer



$9 to $12 USD per hour based on experience

Performance bonuses introduced from 60 days based on outcomes and results

Rate reviewed at 90 days

Long-term role with genuine growth potential

Direct access to and mentorship from the Directors

Exposure to a broad range of digital marketing disciplines

A front-row seat to how AI is changing agency work, and a real role in building it





Why this role is worth your time

You'll work directly with the Directors, be trusted with real client accounts from day one, and have a clear path to taking on more as the business grows. This isn't a role where you clock in, complete a task list, and disappear.

We're a growing agency that does good work and takes it seriously. The person who comes into this role and performs well will have more opportunity here than most agencies would offer. More responsibility, more involvement in where the business is going, and room to grow into a senior position over time.

If you're looking for somewhere to genuinely build a career in digital marketing, this is worth your time.



You'll thrive here if you



Can manage content for multiple brands and keep each one sounding like itself

Get excited when a trend drops and already know how to make it work for a brand

Are comfortable being trusted with a Director's inbox and client communications

Have actually built automations, not just switched them on

Know your way around AI tools and are genuinely curious about where they're going

Come with ideas, not just completed tasks

Are always looking for a better way to do something, not just the way it's always been done

Take pride in being genuinely good at what you do, not just getting it done

Pick up new tools quickly and don't need things explained twice

Spot problems before they're flagged and say something

Want to grow into something bigger, not just tick tasks off a list





This role is not for you if you



Need a lot of hand-holding or detailed daily instruction

Have only worked in-house or as a solo freelancer, never inside an agency

Think using AI means occasionally asking ChatGPT a question

Are happy to complete a task without understanding why it matters

Treat a job description as a strict list of tasks rather than a guide for what the business needs





To apply

Record a Loom video (5 minutes maximum) and include the link in your application. Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.

Your Loom must cover:



Introduce yourself and tell us about your experience working inside a digital marketing agency

Walk us through one automation you have built from scratch, what the problem was and what it solved

Show us an example of content you have created for a client and talk us through your thinking behind it

Tell us what AI tools you use every day and show us how you use at least one of them

Tell us why this role is the right next step for you



We're looking for clear, confident English, specific examples not general claims, and someone who gets genuinely excited talking about this work. Someone who can't be bothered recording a Loom won't progress to the next stage.

title: Full-time Short Form Editor
Remote Executive Admin & Finance (QuickBooks + AI Systems Support)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Are you a detail-oriented, systems-minded Virtual Professional who enjoys keeping financial records organized, building clean trackers, and turning messy information into clear workflows?



We are looking for a proactive Executive Admin & Finance Virtual Professional who can support finance, admin, operations, reporting, and process documentation. This role is ideal for someone who is accurate with numbers, comfortable with QuickBooks or similar accounting tools, and excited about using AI responsibly to make work clearer, faster, and better documented.



This is not just a task-support role. We are looking for someone who thinks in systems - someone who enjoys creating SOPs, checklists, trackers, dashboards, templates, and better ways of managing recurring work.



You may be a great fit if you like organizing details, catching inconsistencies, improving processes, and helping leadership stay financially informed and operationally prepared.



What You Will Do

You will support day-to-day finance, admin, reporting, documentation, and workflow improvement tasks.



Finance & Bookkeeping Support

• Track invoices, receipts, payments, payables, receivables, reimbursements, and vendor records.

• Support QuickBooks Online or similar accounting systems with organized data entry, categorization, and cleanup.

• Assist with bank and credit card reconciliation support.

• Help maintain clean records for transactions, vendors, invoices, and supporting documents.

• Prepare financial trackers, summaries, simple reports, and management updates.

• Organize PDFs, screenshots, receipts, invoices, and related files so records are easy to find and review.

• Spot missing information, duplicate entries, inconsistent categories, and reporting gaps before they become bigger issues.



Executive Admin & Operations Support

• Manage calendars, reminders, meetings, follow-ups, deadlines, and recurring priorities.

• Coordinate administrative details, project trackers, vendor information, forms, and documentation.

• Support research, file organization, task follow-through, and internal updates.

• Give clear progress updates, ask smart questions, and close communication loops.

• Handle sensitive business and administrative information with discretion and professionalism.



Systems, SOPs & AI-Assisted Workflow Support

• Create and maintain SOPs, checklists, trackers, dashboards, templates, and process documentation.

• Turn scattered notes, screenshots, recordings, inbox items, or financial details into clear action steps.

• Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, or similar platforms to support summaries, research, documentation, first drafts, and workflow organization.

• Build simple prompt templates or AI-assisted workflows that make recurring tasks cleaner and faster.

• Review and verify AI output before sharing it.

• Protect confidential information and avoid relying on unchecked AI-generated answers.

• Recommend practical improvements when work is messy, manual, duplicated, or unclear.



Who We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate is organized, accurate, reliable, and comfortable working independently in a remote setup. You should enjoy finance/admin work, but also be curious about systems, documentation, and smarter ways to get things done.



You may be a great fit if you:

• Have at least 2 years of experience in finance/admin, bookkeeping support, executive admin, operations, or a related role.

• Have hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online or a similar accounting platform such as Xero, FreshBooks, Zoho Books, NetSuite, or similar tools.

• Are comfortable handling invoice tracking, AP/AR support, vendor records, reconciliation support, reporting, or financial admin tasks.

• Have strong Excel or Google Sheets skills for trackers, formulas, organized data, and reporting.

• Are highly detail-oriented and careful with numbers, deadlines, and confidential information.

• Can write clear updates in English and communicate proactively.

• Naturally organize recurring work into checklists, templates, SOPs, trackers, or dashboards.

• Are comfortable using AI tools as a work partner for drafting, summarizing, organizing, researching, and improving documentation.

• Understand that AI output must still be checked, verified, and handled responsibly.

• Are resourceful, coachable, proactive, and able to work with minimal supervision.



Preferred Experience: Experience with any of the following is a plus:

• QuickBooks Online cleanup, categorization, reconciliation support, or financial reporting.

• Accounts payable, accounts receivable, invoice tracking, or vendor management.

• KPI dashboards, management reports, data cleanup, or reporting packs.

• SOP creation, Loom/process videos, workflow documentation, trackers, or process maps.

• Project management tools such as ClickUp, Asana, 
, Trello, Notion, or Airtable.

• CRM tools, automation tools, Zapier, Make, or similar platforms.

• Supporting executives, operators, finance teams, or operations-heavy businesses.

• Coordinating applications, vendor setup, compliance research, permits, or project trackers.

• Using AI tools to improve admin, finance, reporting, documentation, or research workflows.



Tech & Infrastructure Requirements

To ensure a smooth and reliable remote work experience, applicants must have:

• Intel i5 10th Gen / AMD Ryzen 5 or higher preferred.

• Minimum 8GB RAM.

• Laptop or PC preferably less than 3 years old.

• Stable internet connection of at least 50-100 Mbps preferred.

• Backup internet connection.

• Quality webcam, microphone, and headset.

Screenshots of device specs and internet speed test may be requested during the application process.



You Will Thrive in This Role If...

• You enjoy bringing order to messy information.

• You like working with numbers, reports, trackers, records, and follow-ups.

• You often think, "There has to be a better system for this."

• You can follow instructions carefully but also think ahead.

• You ask thoughtful questions when information is missing.

• You give clear updates without needing to be chased.

• You enjoy creating checklists, documentation, templates, and better workflows.

• You use AI thoughtfully to improve work quality, not to replace judgment.

• You want a long-term remote role where reliability, ownership, communication, and continuous improvement matter.



This May Not Be the Best Fit If...

- Add text hooks, captions, music, and product tags per the SOP

Maintain consistent daily output, 6 days per week. A skilled VA can complete posting for one account in about 30 minutes. Most VAs cover 2–6 student accounts per day.

WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



- Excellent written English

- Reliable high-speed internet

- Smartphone (iPhone or Android) capable of running TikTok

- 6 days/week availability

- Strong attention to detail — small mistakes cause real account problems

- Comfortable following SOPs precisely (no improvising)

- Comfortable installing and using a VPN application (the student provides the VPN access — you just connect to it before each session)



Bonus: prior TikTok Shop or TikTok posting experience.



———————————————————



HOW TO APPLY



Send the following:



1. A 2–3 minute Loom video — introduce yourself, your VA experience, and why you'd be a good fit

2. Your resume or CV

3. Your timezone + weekly availability (hours/day, days/week)

4. Confirmation you have a smartphone, reliable internet, and can commit 6 days/week

Applications missing item #5 will not be reviewed. We get a lot of applications and use this to filter for people who actually read the listing.



———————————————————

If we like your application, you move into a 3-day paid trial period:



- We walk you through our full Posting SOP via Loom + a short 1:1 call so you know exactly what to do

- You're assigned to one of our students' real accounts for the trial period

- Pass the trial = you continue with that student permanently

- If it's not the right fit, we release you with full pay for hours worked



———————————————————



WHY WORK WITH APEX

- Clear written SOPs — you never have to guess what to do

— Apex Initiative Team

title: Inside Sales And Appointment Setting Assistant
description:

Cash 4 Homes  |  Remote  |  Full-Time  |  40 Hours/Week



About the Role



Cash 4 Homes buys houses directly from motivated sellers. We're hiring a driven Inside Sales and Appointment Setting Assistant to qualify inbound leads, make outbound prospecting calls, and keep our pipeline of seller leads moving. This role is purely sales support — you will not be making offers or negotiating price. Your job is to qualify the lead, gather the right information, and set the appointment.

This is a high-activity phone role. The right person is comfortable on the phone, follows scripts consistently, and treats every conversation with urgency and professionalism. Real estate or wholesaling experience is a strong plus but not required — we will train you on our process.

Key Responsibilities



Lead Qualification & Prospecting

• Answer and qualify warm inbound leads from ads, signs, and referrals

• Make outbound calls to prospect lists (absentee owners, pre-foreclosure, probate, etc.) and follow up on older leads

• Qualify sellers using our scripts and criteria — property condition, mortgage balance, timeline, motivation, occupancy

• Follow up persistently via phone and text until a clear disposition is reached on each lead

• Log every call, note, and disposition accurately in Go High Level (GHL)

Appointment Setting

• Schedule qualified appointments between sellers and our acquisitions contact

• Confirm and remind sellers of upcoming appointments to reduce no-shows

• Keep the appointment calendar in GHL clean, accurate, and up to date

CRM & Communication

• Manage and update all lead records in Go High Level, ensuring pipeline accuracy

• Make and receive calls using a VoIP platform (Dialpad or similar), maintaining a professional, consistent tone

• Communicate with the team via Slack for updates, handoffs, and coordination

• Follow up on every lead that isn't a hard no — nothing falls through the cracks

What You Will NOT Be Responsible For



• Making cash offers or negotiating price with sellers

• Designing the sales process — we provide the scripts and you follow them, with room to give feedback as we refine

Qualifications



• Experience with a CRM platform (Go High Level experience is a strong plus, but not required — we will train)

• Comfortable with VoIP calling platforms (Dialpad or similar) for high-volume calling

• Comfortable using Slack for team communication

• Strong spoken English with a confident, professional phone presence

• Self-motivated and able to hit daily call and follow-up targets independently

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail in CRM record-keeping

• Real estate, wholesaling, or sales experience is a plus, but not required

Schedule & Compensation



This is a full-time remote position, 40 hours per week, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Central Time (Montgomery, AL time zone), with a 1-hour unpaid break. Compensation: $700–$900 USD per month, based on experience.

Equipment



This is an independent contractor position. You will need to supply your own computer, headset, and reliable high-speed internet connection. We provide access to our software tools, including Go High Level (CRM) and our VoIP calling platform.

Screening Questions (for OnlineJobs.ph posting)



• Have you used Go High Level (GHL) or a similar CRM before? If yes, describe what you used it for.

title: Meta Ads Creative Strategist
description:
Job Overview

We are a fast-growing Shopify direct-to-consumer (DTC) sleep technology brand, and we are looking for a highly analytical, sharp, and proactive Creative Strategist for Meta Ads.



To be incredibly clear: This is NOT a graphic design or video editing role. You will not be pushing pixels in Figma or editing timelines in Premiere.



You are the architect of our ad account. Your job is to conduct deep market research, understand consumer psychology, develop high-converting direct response (DR) angles, and write airtight creative briefs for our design and editing teams. You must understand why people buy and know how to structure a scroll-stopping hook and a persuasive script that sells.



If you are someone who waits to be handed a list of ideas to brief, or if you just guess what might look "cool" without looking at the data, this is not the role for you. We need a strategic powerhouse who owns the creative testing roadmap from insight to execution to analysis.



Core Responsibilities

- Deep Avatar & Market Research: Obsessively research our target demographic. You will scour competitor ad libraries, mine customer reviews, read Reddit threads, and analyze TikTok comments to uncover hidden pain points and desires.  

- Angle & Concept Ideation: Develop original, direct response advertising angles. You will translate your research into structured concepts (e.g., problem/solution, Us vs. Them, scientific proof/temperature control comparisons, emotional triggers). 

- Airtight Creative Briefing: Write highly detailed, idiot-proof creative briefs and video scripts for our designers and editors. Your briefs must clearly define the hook, the visual layout, the on-screen text, the pacing, and the core CTA.  

- Creative Performance Analysis: You won't just launch briefs and forget them. You will actively analyze performance data in Meta Ads Manager and our attribution software (e.g., Northbeam, Triple Whale) to diagnose hook rates, thumb-stop ratios, and CPA. You must be able to explain why an ad won or lost.  

- Testing Roadmap Management: Build and manage our weekly creative testing pipeline, ensuring a consistent flow of fresh concepts, iterative variations of winning ads, and new format tests.  



Required Qualifications & Skills

- Direct Response Mastery is Mandatory: You must have a deep, proven understanding of what makes a Meta ad convert. You know the anatomy of a winning ad, consumer psychology, and how to structure a pitch that drives immediate action.

- Exceptional Copywriting & Scripting: Flawless written English. You must be able to write punchy, persuasive video scripts, ad copy, and headlines that resonate with a US-based consumer.

- Data Literacy: You must be comfortable reading data. You know the difference between a creative problem (low hook rate) and a landing page problem (high CTR, low CVR), and you use that data to guide your next brief.

- Proactive & Independent: You do not need to be micromanaged. You independently spot fatigue in our ad account, research what competitors are scaling, and pitch your own concepts.

- Reliable Setup: High-speed internet connection (with a backup plan) and a reliable computer.



Nice-to-Haves (Not Mandatory)

- Prior experience strategizing for sleep-tech, health/wellness, or high-AOV premium home goods brands.

- Familiarity with creative research and saving tools like Foreplay or Atria.



How to Apply:

If you are sharp, obsessed with consumer psychology, and ready to be the brains behind our Meta ad engine, please reply with:

- A link to a portfolio or Google Drive folder containing 2–3 examples of creative briefs or scripts you have written that resulted in profitable ads, and the images/videos of those ads (if available).

title: Right-Hand VA (Marketing Focused) — Clean Christian Music App
description:
We're looking for a sharp, creative, trend-obsessed marketer who lives on social media and loves using AI to make great content faster and smarter. The heart of this role is organic social — finding what's working right now, testing new content types before everyone else does, and turning scrolls into follows, clicks, and customers. You'll have real ownership over what we post, how it performs, and where we grow next.



If you get a little thrill from spotting a trend early, trying a format nobody's done yet, watching the analytics climb, and making a piece of content better than you found it — you'll fit right in. You don't need to have done all of this before, but you do need to be excited to learn. We use AI every day, and you'll use it to move faster: drafting, repurposing, researching, and creating gorgeous visuals.



It's a mixed role, and we want to be upfront about that. Organic social and marketing are the core of what we're hiring for — but you'll also help with customer service for our clean Christian music app, a bit of general admin, and whatever else a small, growing team needs. You need to be genuinely open to pitching in wherever we need you. We use tools like Claude (and Claude Code) every day, and we'll teach you how we work.



If you anticipate what's needed before being asked, take real ownership, communicate like a pro, and love learning something new — keep reading.



We're hiring the person, not the résumé. Creativity, instincts, and drive matter most; the rest we can teach — including the AI tools we build with.



What you'll do



Own our organic social (the core). Plan, create, and post across our platforms; catch trends early and act on them fast; test new content types and formats; build engaged audiences and keep them growing. This is the heart of the role.



Make scroll-stopping content — with an eye for design. Create visuals that look premium and on-brand, using AI image tools (Midjourney, Ideogram, gpt-image, and friends) to produce gorgeous images quickly. Good taste matters here.



Grow beyond organic. Pitch in on
 marketing, funnels, paid ads, and influencer marketing as we scale. You don't need to be an expert in all of it — but you should be eager to learn it and run with it.



Turn data into insight. Monitor analytics across platforms, spot what's working (and what's not), and bring us clear takeaways — not just numbers. Then double down on the winners.



Use AI to work faster and smarter. Lean on Claude / ChatGPT (and grow into Claude Code) to draft content, repurpose it across platforms, research, and automate the tedious parts of content ops. We'll teach you; you bring the curiosity.



Be my right hand. Anticipate needs, follow through without reminders, flag issues early, and close loops.



Support our clean Christian music app — content, community, customer service, and launch-related help.



Pitch in on the rest — light e-commerce / Etsy support and general admin as we grow.



A real love of music is a big plus — you'll be working in it every day.



Who you are (this matters most to us)



Creative and trend-obsessed — this is the big one. You live on social, you catch trends before they peak, and you have strong instincts for what makes people stop, save, and share.



An eye for design. You know what looks good, and you can create (or AI-assist) visuals that feel premium and on-brand.



Very proactive — a true self-starter. You take initiative instead of waiting to be told, teach yourself what you don't know, and your first instinct on a repetitive task is "can I make this faster?"



Tech-curious and AI-friendly. You're energized (not intimidated) by AI tools, and you're excited to use them every day to create and move faster. Any interest in automation or tinkering is a real plus.



Comfortable with numbers. You actually look at the analytics and let them guide your next test.



Great — not necessarily experienced. Eager, smart, proactive, and resourceful. We'd take a brilliant fast-learner over a seasoned coaster every single time.



Open and flexible. Happy to jump from a content project to a customer-service question to a quick admin task without missing a beat. You're here for the creative and marketing work, but you don't consider anything "below" you.



A clear communicator — responsive, easy to work with, and good at keeping us in the loop.



Reliable and professional — you do what you say you'll do, and you have a stable internet connection good enough to hold a video call and screen-share without dropping.



Honest and accountable — you log the time you actually work and speak up early when something's off. This one is non-negotiable.



Detail-oriented. To show us you read carefully, please mention your favorite color in your application where it asks how you heard about us.



Mission-aligned — you genuinely connect with what we're building: clean, faith-friendly music for families.



Helpful (but NOT required — we'll train you)



Hands-on organic social experience (TikTok, Instagram / Reels, Pinterest, YouTube Shorts,
).

Any experience with
 marketing, funnels, paid ads (Meta, etc.), or influencer marketing.

AI image generation (Midjourney, Ideogram, gpt-image) and design tools (Canva, Figma, etc.).

Using ChatGPT, Claude, or other AI tools in your daily workflow — bonus points for Claude / Claude Code or automation (n8n, Make, Zapier).

Reading analytics to spot trends and report results.

Pinterest / social media scheduling tools.

Customer service experience.

WordPress publishing.

Influencer outreach and management.

The details



Full-time, 40 hrs/week, long-term.

We start at $400–500/month and there's room to grow — in both pay and responsibility — as you take on more and grow into the wider marketing and AI side.

Based in the Philippines, with some flexibility to occasionally overlap U.S. Mountain Time for a quick call or chat.

We use the time tracker Trackabi for active work hours.

Benefits



Flexible hours — days, nights, spread out, or catch up on weekends.

PTO after 6 months full-time.

Paid training time to learn new skills on the clock.

A genuinely great team and culture. I treat my team like friends, not just freelancers — many have been with me for years, with no plans of leaving.

How to apply



Apply through the Google Form here: 
  — that's the only way to apply, so please don't DM or
 instead.



Two quick things in the form:



When it asks about your experience with AI tools, tell us about a time you taught yourself something new — a tool, a content format, or a campaign — what you did and how it turned out. There's no "right" answer; we just want to see how you think and learn.



We're hiring one person and reviewing applications as they come in. Top candidates get a paid test project — your real chance to show us how you work.



If creating content, chasing trends, and using AI to do it all faster sounds more like a chore than something you'd genuinely enjoy, this probably isn't the right fit — and that's completely okay. But if everything above sounds like you, we'd genuinely love to meet you.

description:

You will be responsible for keeping our QuickBooks Online (QBC) 100?curate, clean, and audit-ready. 



You must deeply understand the unique challenges of eCommerce accounting, specifically how to reconcile complex Amazon and Walmart payouts and how to properly handle capitalized freight costs.

• Inventory & COGS Accounting: Properly account for capitalized inventory. Allocate shipping fees (like Amazon AGL) to inventory value (Asset) and only recognize them as COGS when the product is sold.

• Bank & Credit Card Matching: Keep track of all expenses, software subscriptions, and factory payments across all bank accounts.

• Financial Reporting: Generate accurate monthly P&L (Profit & Loss) statements, Balance Sheets, and Cash Flow reports.



Requirements:

• Certified QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor or a solid degree in Accounting/Finance.

• At least 2+ years of verified experience in eCommerce Bookkeeping (Amazon/Walmart mandatory).

• Deep understanding of Accrual vs. Cash basis accounting for inventory and COGS.

• Flawless written English and excellent communication skills.

title: Senior Zoho Solutions Architect / Developer
description:
Who We Are



Inside Sales Solutions helps leading technology companies accelerate growth by delivering world-class lead generation and appointment-setting services. As we continue expanding our Zoho One platform following a major migration, we're looking for an experienced Zoho professional to help us build the next generation of our internal business systems.



This is not a maintenance role.



We're looking for someone who enjoys solving complex business problems, designing scalable solutions, and building applications, reporting, and automation that become the operational backbone of a growing organization.



If you enjoy taking ownership of a Zoho environment, improving existing architecture, and building elegant long-term solutions instead of quick fixes, we'd love to hear from you.



Key Responsibilities

CRM & Solution Architecture

Design, optimize, and maintain scalable solutions across Zoho CRM, Creator, Analytics, Projects, Desk, Campaigns, and other Zoho One applications.

Evaluate existing architecture and recommend improvements that increase scalability, performance, and maintainability.

Refactor or redesign legacy workflows and applications where appropriate.

Custom Application Development

Design, build, and enhance custom applications in Zoho Creator.

Develop business workflows supporting operations, HR, reporting, sales, and client management.

Deluge Development & Automation

Develop clean, modular Deluge functions.

Build advanced workflow automation, approval processes, scheduled jobs, custom functions, and business logic.

Improve existing code to reduce technical debt and improve reliability.

Reporting, Dashboards & Analytics

Design executive, operational, and departmental dashboards using Zoho Analytics.

Build scalable reporting that delivers meaningful KPIs and business insights.

Develop reporting for operational metrics, campaign performance, productivity, quality, and incentive tracking.

Ensure reporting remains accurate, performant, and maintainable as business requirements evolve.

System Integration

Integrate Zoho applications with one another and third-party platforms using REST APIs, webhooks, Zoho Flow, and custom integrations.

Troubleshoot integration issues and improve data synchronization across systems.

Data & System Optimization

Improve data integrity, architecture, and performance following our CRM migration.

Reduce manual processes through automation and thoughtful system design.

Optimize database structures, layouts, fields, modules, and relationships.

Collaboration

Work directly with business leaders to understand operational challenges and translate them into scalable technical solutions.

Recommend best practices rather than simply implementing requests.

Produce clear technical documentation for future maintenance.

Required Qualifications

Advanced experience developing solutions within Zoho One.

Expert-level Deluge scripting experience.

Strong experience with Zoho CRM and Zoho Creator.

Hands-on experience building dashboards and reporting using Zoho Analytics.

Experience designing scalable CRM architecture rather than simply configuring workflows.

Experience inheriting and optimizing existing Zoho environments.

Strong understanding of APIs, REST services, webhooks, and system integrations.

Knowledge of relational databases and data modeling.

Experience troubleshooting production systems and minimizing technical debt.

Strong communication skills with the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

Zoho Certified Developer.

Experience building operational KPI dashboards and executive reporting.

Experience designing CRM data models and reporting structures.

title: DTC Video Editor
description:
Sweat Pants Agency is a performance marketing agency and the ONLY agency behind multiple INC #1 fast-growing brands. We create, test, and scale ads across Meta, TikTok, Instagram, and other paid social platforms.



We are looking for a DTC Video Editor who can turn raw UGC, talking-head footage, product clips, client assets, AI-generated b-roll, and social references into engaging, platform-native ads.



This is a remote role and requires strong English communication skills.



Most of our creative is built for Meta, so this role is ideal for someone who understands paid social ads, direct response creative, UGC-style editing, short-form hooks, and fast creative iteration.



This is not just a “make it look nice” editing role. We are looking for someone who understands the difference between a beautiful edit and an effective ad.



You should be able to look at a video and think:



“Where would someone drop off?”

 “How do we make the hook stronger?”

 “Does this feel native to the platform?”

 “Does the edit support the angle?”

 “Is this persuasive from a consumer’s perspective?”



You will work closely with creative strategists, media buyers, and creative directors to edit paid social ads for ecommerce brands. The ideal candidate has strong instincts around hooks, pacing, retention, direct response structure, captions, audio, b-roll, AI tools, and what makes content feel native to platforms like Meta, Instagram, and TikTok.



You should also be comfortable using AI tools to improve the creative process. This may include generating natural-looking filler footage, creating product b-roll, producing AI voiceovers, transcribing scenes, analyzing competitor ads, or speeding up editing workflows.



What You’ll Do



Edit Paid Social Ads



- Edit performance-driven video ads for Meta, Instagram, TikTok, Reels, and other short-form platforms 

- Turn raw UGC, talking-head footage, testimonials, product demos, founder content, and creator-style clips into finished ads 

- Create multiple hooks, angles, and video variations for creative testing 

-  Build strong first-three-second hooks with visual impact 

-  Repurpose existing footage into new ad concepts and variations 

-  Make videos feel native to the platform, not like overproduced brand commercials 



Bring Direct Response Creative Instincts



-  Edit videos around direct response structures such as problem, agitation, solution, proof, and CTA 

- Match the editing style to the footage, offer, brand, and creative angle 

- Know when an ad should feel organic, handheld, raw, and native 

- Know when an ad should feel more polished, premium, or brand-forward 

- Use pacing, captions, pattern interrupts, b-roll, visual proof, and sound to keep people watching 

- Make the ad feel cohesive rather than stitched together with random filler 

- Think from the consumer’s perspective, not just the editor’s perspective 



Improve Hooks, Pacing, and Retention



- Strengthen hook visuals and opening 
nts 

- Improve pacing, scene order, and visual flow 

- Add captions, overlays, text callouts, screenshots, sound cues, and pattern interrupts 

- Identify 
nts where viewers may drop off and improve the edit accordingly 

- Create edits that are clear, engaging, persuasive, and easy to follow 

- Use sound design and audio pacing to make videos more engaging 



Use AI Tools in the Creative Workflow



- Use AI tools to generate natural-looking filler footage or additional product b-roll when client footage is limited 

- Match AI-generated footage to the quality, lighting, environment, and realism of the original clips 

- Use AI voiceover tools when applicable 

- Use AI tools for transcription, scene analysis, competitor ad comparison, and creative research 

- Understand when AI improves an edit and when it makes the video feel unnatural 

- Stay curious about new creative tools and workflows 



Collaborate With the Creative Team



- Read creative briefs and ask smart questions when something is unclear 

- Communicate estimated completion times before starting work 

- Send an initial draft for review when working on a new format or a brief with multiple variants 

- Take feedback from strategists, media buyers, and creative directors 

- Revise quickly and communicate clearly around blockers, timelines, and priorities 

- Pull inspiration from winning ads, organic content, competitor ads, and top creators 

- Recommend new creative angles, hooks, structures, and references when appropriate 



You’re a Great Fit If...



- You have 2 to 5+ years of video editing experience 

- You have experience editing paid social ads, UGC-style content, short-form content, or DTC ecommerce ads 

- You understand what makes content feel native to Meta, Instagram, TikTok, and Reels 

- You have strong instincts for hooks, pacing, retention, and visual flow 

- You understand direct response advertising and performance creative 

- You can tell the difference between content that is visually aesthetic and content that is persuasive to a consumer 

- You know how to adapt the edit based on the footage style, whether it should feel raw and organic or polished and premium 

- You are strong with captions, typography, sound design, overlays, and voiceover pacing 

- You can create multiple ad variations quickly without sacrificing quality 

- You ask questions when a brief is unclear 

- You communicate clearly about timelines, revisions, and blockers 

- You are comfortable using AI tools in your creative workflow 

- You have a strong sense of what keeps viewers watching 



Tools You Should Be Comfortable With



You do not need to know every tool listed, but you should be fast at learning new creative tools.



- Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve 

- CapCut 

- Meta ad creative references and competitor research 

- TikTok native editor 

- Instagram native editor 

- ElevenLabs or similar AI voiceover tools 

- Higgsfield or similar AI image and video tools 

- Gemini, ChatGPT, or similar tools for transcription, scene analysis, and creative research 

- AI tools for image, video, voiceover, b-roll, and clip generation 

- Google Drive, Slack, Notion, 
, or similar collaboration tools 



Nice to Have



- Experience editing direct response DTC ads 

- Experience working with paid social creative teams 

- Experience editing Meta ads specifically 

- Experience researching Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center, or competitor ads 

- Experience creating viral organic short-form content

mber who understands the current workflow

title: Remote Operations VA - US Car Rental (Phone, GoHighLevel, Clear English a MUST)
description:
About us:

Odel Rentals is a U.S.-based car rental company in Maryland. We rent cars to gig drivers (Uber, DoorDash, Instacart, Amazon Flex) and to direct renters. We run on GoHighLevel (GHL) and we use an AI assistant to help run the business. We are a small, fast-moving team that values clear communication, discipline, and real ownership. Do great work here and you grow with us.



What you will do:

You are the main person talking to our U.S. renters and keeping the operation organized. This is a phone-first job. You must be comfortable calling people, sounding warm and professional, and helping renters on the phone.

- Call new leads fast, answer inbound calls, explain our service, and qualify renters.

- Collect and review renter documents (driver's license, gig-earnings screenshot, proof of residency) and spot anything fake, expired, or mismatched.

- Run background checks and judge them. Auto-fail theft, violence, or fraud history. Escalate when unsure.

- Coordinate pickups and returns. No car is released without confirmed payment AND a signed agreement.

- Help manage our AI dashboard: it writes draft messages for you to check, and you catch the bad ones before they go out.

- Keep our GoHighLevel CRM clean: work leads, move them through the pipeline, log every call and note, run follow-ups.

- Track payments, send reminders, update our fleet and revenue sheets, and store documents where they belong.



Must-haves (read carefully):

1. CLEAR, NEUTRAL SPOKEN ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. This is a phone job with U.S. customers. You must be easy for an American to understand on the first try. This is our number one requirement, no exceptions.

2. Strong written English.

3. Comfortable on the phone. You can call people and not get rattled.

4. Sharp eye for risky renters and fake documents.

5. Detail-obsessed and reliable. You log everything and follow a written process exactly.

6. CRM experience. GoHighLevel (GHL) strongly preferred. If you are strong on the phone and have used another CRM, we will train you on GHL.

7. You can reliably work U.S. Eastern daytime hours (your night) long-term.

8. Good internet, a working headset, a quiet place to take calls, and a backup for power or wifi outages.



Nice-to-haves:

- Bilingual English/Spanish (many gig drivers are Spanish-first).

- Hands-on GoHighLevel experience.

- U.S. car rental, Turo, or transportation experience.

- Spreadsheets and background-check tools (Intelius, Forewarn). Comfort with AI tools.



Hours and pay: Full-time, U.S. Eastern Time daytime, the same full hours every day, long-term. This role pays up to $5 per hour (about $500 to $866 per month), based on your experience. Only apply if that works for you. You start on a smaller set of tasks (lead response, phone calls, helping manage our AI dashboard) and take on more as you prove out.



HOW TO APPLY (follow this exactly or you will be skipped):

Do NOT send a generic copy-paste reply. In your application, answer ALL of these questions in order. To prove you read this whole post, work the words "FULL TANK" into one of your answers in a full sentence (not just the words by themselves). Applications that skip the questions or leave out "FULL TANK" will not be reviewed.

1. Have you worked in a role where you handled structured processes and strict deadlines? Give an example.

2. How comfortable are you making phone calls daily with U.S. customers? About how many calls per day have you done, and what kind?

3. What experience do you have specifically with GoHighLevel (GHL)? If you have used it, describe exactly what you did in it. If not, what other CRM have you used?

4. What U.S. hours can you reliably work long-term, and can you keep a U.S. Eastern daytime schedule (your night)?

5. Where did you learn English, and can a U.S. customer easily understand you on the phone? Be honest.

6. Have you ever reviewed ID documents, run background checks, or screened customers? Describe it.

7. Scenario: a renter wants to take the car tonight but has not paid yet and has not signed the agreement. What do you do?

8. What is your expected pay (per hour or per month)? This role pays up to $5 per hour, so only apply if that works for you.



Plus a 60 to 90 second Loom or video recording where you introduce yourself in English and read this line out loud in a natural voice: "Hi, thanks for calling Odel Rentals, are you currently a gig driver and how long are you looking to rent?" Paste the link in your application. No video means we will not review it. This is how we hear your phone voice.

title: EA / Book Keeper
description:
About the role

I’m an executive running ann entertainment/talent supply business — and I’m looking for a sharp, reliable Executive Assistant who can also handle bookkeeping. This is a true right-hand role. I move fast across a lot of projects, and I need someone who can keep everything on track without me having to chase it.

If you’re organized to the point of being slightly obsessive, you like systems, and you take genuine ownership of your work, we’ll get along well.

What you’ll do

 • Keep projects and tasks on track — manage and maintain task lists, project boards, and deadlines across both businesses so nothing slips

 • Run point in Airtable — update records, maintain pipelines, keep data clean and accurate, and help me get the most out of our systems

 • Bookkeeping — record transactions, reconcile accounts, track income and expenses, organize receipts/invoices, and keep the books current and tidy

 • Inbox and calendar support — help triage
, schedule, and follow up so things don’t fall through the cracks

 • General EA support — research, document prep, follow-ups, and the dozens of small things that keep a busy founder moving

 • Flag and follow up proactively — tell me what needs my attention, chase what’s outstanding, and close loops without being reminded

What I’m looking for

 • Trustworthy — you’ll have access to sensitive information and financials; integrity is non-negotiable

 • Independent and driven — you can take a goal, run with it, and figure things out without hand-holding

 • Highly organized — you naturally keep track of moving pieces and never lose the thread

 • Strong written English — clear, professional communication

 • Detail-oriented — accuracy matters a lot, especially with the books

Required experience

 • Experience as an EA / VA supporting a founder or executive managing multiple projects

 • Bookkeeping experience (we currently operate QuickBooks and have recently started an IRA option for the team)

 • Comfortable with task/project management

Nice to have (a big plus)

 • Airtable experience — this is the system that runs my businesses, so familiarity here moves you to the top of the pile

 • Experience with shared inboxes (Missive), automation tools (Make), or AI tools

 • Experience in entertainment, hospitality/cruise, or travel

The arrangement

We’ll start with a 3-month paid trial so we can both make sure it’s a great fit. If the trial goes well — and I expect it to with the right person — this becomes a permanent, long-term full-time role with room to grow as my businesses do. I want to find someone I can build with for years, not just fill a seat.

How to apply

Please don’t send a generic application. To show me you read this carefully:

 1. Start your message with the word “Anchor” so I know you read to the end.

 2. Tell me briefly about a founder or executive you’ve supported, and one thing you did that made their life easier.

 3. List the bookkeeping tool(s) you’ve used and your level of Airtable experience (none / some / strong).

 4. Attach/supply your resume if you have one.

Applications that follow these steps get read first. I’m looking forward to meeting you.

eting a deadline

ssages

* Setting realistic expectations

* Keeping communication professional, organized, and easy to understand

* Making sure clients do not have to ask us repeatedly for updates



Clients should feel that their project is organized, actively managed, and moving forward.



### Communicate With the Team



You will communicate with our team throughout the workday, Monday through Friday.



This includes:



* Reviewing progress with tea
mbers

* Following up on tasks

* Answering project-related questions

* Clarifying priorities

* Identifying blockers

* Confirming deadlines

* Making sure tea
mbers understand what is expected

* Communicating important client feedback

* Helping the team determine what should be worked on next



You must be comfortable holding people accountable respectfully and directly.



### Own and Improve ClickUp



ClickUp is the primary project management system used by Frisco Web Agency.



You will be expected to:



* Keep ClickUp accurate and up to date

* Make sure tasks are assigned correctly

* Maintain deadlines, statuses, dependencies, and priorities

* Ensure task descriptions contain enough information for the work to be completed

* Keep client and internal communication organized

* Improve dashboards, templates, automations, and workflows

* Identify areas where ClickUp is becoming confusing or inefficient

* Recommend and implement improvements

* Make ClickUp a reliable source of truth for the entire company



At any time, we should be able to open ClickUp and quickly understand the status of every project.



### Maintain Company Playbooks



We use the Buy Back Your Time playbook method to document how work should be completed.



You will help:



* Create playbooks for repeatable processes

* Update playbooks when our processes change

* Organize instructions, videos, links, and resources

* Identify missing documentation

* Make sure tea
mbers follow the documented process

* Improve processes based on problems that occur during fulfillment



Our goal is to build a company that does not depend on information being stored only in one person’s head.



## What We Are Looking For



The right person for this role is:



* Highly organized

* Proactive

* Dependable

* Detail-oriented

* Comfortable following up with people

* Able to communicate professionally with clients

* Able to manage several projects at the same time

* Calm when priorities change

* Willing to take ownership of outcomes

* Able to think several steps ahead

* Comfortable asking questions when something is unclear

* Able to make decisions without needing constant approval

* Interested in improving systems and processes

* Consistent with communication

* Able to identify potential delays before deadlines are missed



You should naturally notice when something has not been completed and take action without waiting to be reminded.



## This Role Is Not a Good Fit If You:



* Wait for someone to tell you every next step

* Avoid difficult conversations or follow-ups

* Regularly forget details

* Are uncomfortable holding others accountable

* Only update ClickUp when someone reminds you

* Become overwhelmed when managing several projects

* Disappear during your working hours

* Allow unanswered questions to sit unresolved

* Assume that someone else will take responsibility

* Communicate vaguely or leave people uncertain

* Prefer completing isolated tasks instead of owning the overall outcome



## Required Qualifications



* Previous experience in project management, operations, or client coordination

* Experience using ClickUp or a similar project management platform

* Strong written and spoken English

* Strong organizational and time-management skills

* Experience communicating with clients through
 and meetings

* Reliable computer and internet connection

* Ability to work independently

* Ability to manage multiple deadlines and projects

* Ability to document and improve processes

* Willingness to learn website development and SEO fulfillment processes



Experience working for a web design, marketing, SEO, or digital agency is strongly preferred.



## Working Hours and Availability



This is a full-time position requiring 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday.



You must be available for a daily meeting with Christopher at:



**8:00 a.m. Central Time, Monday through Friday**



Because this is a communication-heavy role, you must also be responsive and available during your agreed working hours. Your working schedule will be established so that you have enough overlap with Christopher, the team, and our clients.



This is not a position where you can complete all your work without communicating with the team. Active communication throughout the workweek is an essential part of the job.



## Trial Period and Payment



This position will begin with a 90-day trial period.



During the trial period, we will evaluate:



* Reliability

* Communication

* Organization

* Ownership

* Ability to manage deadlines

* ClickUp management

* Client communication

* Team coordination

* Ability to keep projects moving

* Overall fit with the company



You will be paid every two weeks. You will complete each two-week work period and then receive payment for that completed period.



**Starting compensation: [INSERT MONTHLY SALARY OR HOURLY RATE]**



There is room for increased responsibility, compensation, and long-term growth as Frisco Web Agency grows.



## What Success Looks Like



You will be successful in this role when:



* Christopher no longer has to personally manage every project

* Every project has a clear status, owner, deadline, and next step

* Tea
mbers know what they should be working on

* Clients receive proactive communication

* Delays are identified and addressed early

* ClickUp is consistently accurate

* Tasks do not disappear or remain forgotten

* Projects are completed on time or ahead of schedule

* Company processes are documented and continuously improved

* You can clearly explain the status of every active project without confusion or uncertainty



The long-term goal is for you to fully own project fulfillment so Christopher can focus on marketing, sales, leadership, and growing the business.



## How to Apply



Please include the following information in your application:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your previous project management experience

3. Your experience using ClickUp

4. Any experience managing website or SEO projects

5. An example of a project that was falling behind and how you moved it forward

6. Your approach to following up with a tea
mber who repeatedly misses deadlines

7. Your internet speed and computer specifications

8. Confirmation that you can attend a daily meeting at 8:00 a.m. Central Time

9. Your expected monthly salary

10. A short video introduction explaining why you believe you would be a strong fit for this position



At the beginning of your application, include the words:



**“I push projects forward.”**



Applications that do not include this phrase will not be considered.
